definitions.en: v declare invalid

definitions.en: v show to be invalid
definitions.zh: [化] 使等于零; 作废

examples.en: The new law will nullify the old one.
examples.zh: 新法律将废除旧法律。

examples.en: The court decided to nullify the contract.
examples.zh: 法院决定宣布合同无效。

definitions.en: s. skillful in physical movements; especially of the hands
definitions.zh: a. 敏捷熟练的, 灵巧的

examples.en: The surgeon's deft hands performed the operation.
examples.zh: 外科医生灵巧的双手进行了手术。

examples.en: She gave a deft reply to the difficult question.
examples.zh: 她对那个难题给出了巧妙的回答。

definitions.en: n. someone who censures or condemns
definitions.zh: n. 检查员

definitions.en: n. a person who is authorized to read publications or correspondence or to watch theatrical performances and suppress in whole or in part anything considered obscene or politically unacceptable
definitions.zh: vt. 检查, 审查, 删改

examples.en: The censor removed some scenes from the film.
examples.zh: 审查员删除了电影中的一些场景。

examples.en: They censor all letters before sending them.
examples.zh: 他们在寄出前审查所有信件。

definitions.en: s brief and to the point; effectively cut short; `yes'"
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 扼要的

examples.en: His terse reply was just 'yes' or 'no'.
examples.zh: 他简洁的回答只是‘是’或‘不是’。

examples.en: She gave a terse summary of the meeting.
examples.zh: 她对会议做了一个简洁的总结。

definitions.en: n. a passage selected from a larger work
definitions.zh: n. 摘录

definitions.en: v. take out of a literary work in order to cite or copy
definitions.zh: v. 引用, 摘录

examples.en: He read an excerpt from the novel aloud.
examples.zh: 他大声朗读了小说的一段摘录。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to excerpt key points.
examples.zh: 老师要求我们摘录关键点。

definitions.en: s briefly giving the gist of something
definitions.zh: a. 简洁的, 紧缩的

examples.en: Her speech was succinct and very clear.
examples.zh: 她的演讲简洁明了。

examples.en: He gave a succinct answer to the question.
examples.zh: 他对问题给出了一个简洁的回答。

definitions.en: s worthy of high praise
definitions.zh: a. 值得赞赏的, 值得佩服的
[医] 健康的

examples.en: Her effort is truly laudable.
examples.zh: 她的努力确实值得赞赏。

examples.en: That was a laudable goal.
examples.zh: 那是一个值得称赞的目标。

definitions.en: a. capable of being perceived by the mind or senses
definitions.zh: a. 可察觉的, 能感觉得到的, 看得见的

examples.en: There was a perceptible change in temperature.
examples.zh: 温度有可察觉的变化。

examples.en: A slight smile was perceptible on her face.
examples.zh: 她脸上能看出淡淡的微笑。

definitions.en: v. be a mystery or bewildering to
definitions.zh: vt. 使困惑, 使复杂化, 使为难
[法] 困惑, 使复杂化, 使纠缠不清

examples.en: The difficult question will perplex the students.
examples.zh: 这个难题会使学生们困惑。

examples.en: His strange behavior began to perplex me.
examples.zh: 他奇怪的行为开始让我困惑。

definitions.en: n. an equal exchange
definitions.zh: n. 物物交换, 实物交易

definitions.en: v. exchange goods without involving money
definitions.zh: v. 物物交换, 交换

examples.en: They used barter to trade goods without money.
examples.zh: 他们用物物交换来交易货物，不用钱。

examples.en: In some villages, people still barter for food.
examples.zh: 在一些村庄，人们仍然用物物交换换取食物。

definitions.en: n. fabric comprising a fitted part at the top of a garment
definitions.zh: n. 轭, 牛轭, 束缚

definitions.en: n. an oppressive power
definitions.zh: vt. 给...上轭, 连接, 结合, 使匹配

definitions.en: n. a pair of draft animals joined by a yoke
definitions.zh: vi. 结合, 匹配

examples.en: The farmer put a yoke on the oxen.
examples.zh: 农夫给牛套上轭。

examples.en: They tried to yoke the two ideas together.
examples.zh: 他们试图把这两个想法结合起来。

definitions.en: a. giving careful attention to detail; hard to please; excessively concerned with cleanliness
definitions.zh: a. 难取悦的, 挑剔的, 苛求的

examples.en: She is fastidious about her appearance.
examples.zh: 她对她的外表很挑剔。

examples.en: He is a fastidious eater who dislikes mess.
examples.zh: 他是个挑剔的食客，不喜欢杂乱。

definitions.en: s. of an incalculable amount
definitions.zh: a. 未说过的, 未透露的, 未加叙述的, 数不清的, 无限的, 不可计量的, 无数的
[法] 未说明的, 未方露的, 未说出的

examples.en: The storm caused untold damage to the city.
examples.zh: 风暴给城市造成了数不清的损失。

examples.en: She has untold wealth hidden away.
examples.zh: 她藏有数不清的财富。

definitions.en: v. persist stubbornly
definitions.zh: a. 倔强的, 顽固的, 不让步的

examples.en: The obstinate child refused to eat vegetables.
examples.zh: 这个倔强的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。

examples.en: He is obstinate and never changes his mind.
examples.zh: 他很顽固，从不改变主意。

definitions.en: v. make politically neutral and thus inoffensive
definitions.zh: vt. 使中立, 使成中立地带, 使中和, 抵销

definitions.en: v. make ineffective by counterbalancing the effect of
definitions.zh: vi. 中立化, 变无效, 中和

examples.en: The medicine helps neutralize the acid.
examples.zh: 这种药有助于中和酸。

examples.en: They tried to neutralize the threat quickly.
examples.zh: 他们试图迅速消除威胁。

definitions.en: a. relating to or involving ships or shipping or navigation or seamen
definitions.zh: a. 海上的, 航海的, 船员的

examples.en: He loves nautical adventures on the sea.
examples.zh: 他喜欢海上的航海冒险。

examples.en: The room had a nautical theme with anchors.
examples.zh: 房间有航海主题，装饰着锚。

definitions.en: v force somebody to do something
definitions.zh: a. 乐于施惠的, 体贴的, 有礼貌的

examples.en: The obliging waiter helped us with the menu.
examples.zh: 乐于施惠的服务员帮我们看菜单。

examples.en: She is an obliging person who always assists.
examples.zh: 她是个乐于施惠的人，总是帮忙。

definitions.en: v. harass or assault sexually; make indecent advances to
definitions.zh: vt. 妨碍, 干扰, 调戏
[法] 调戏, 作弄, 恶意干涉

examples.en: It is wrong to molest anyone.
examples.zh: 骚扰任何人都是错误的。

examples.en: The law punishes those who molest others.
examples.zh: 法律惩罚那些骚扰他人的人。

definitions.en: s. greatly exceeding bounds of reason or moderation
definitions.zh: a. 过度的, 过高的, 过分的

examples.en: The price of that car is exorbitant.
examples.zh: 那辆车的价格过高。

examples.en: They charged an exorbitant fee for the service.
examples.zh: 他们对这项服务收取了过高的费用。

definitions.en: v. disturb in mind or make uneasy or cause to be worried or alarmed
definitions.zh: vt. 扰乱, 使混乱, 使心绪不宁

examples.en: The news did not perturb him.
examples.zh: 这消息没有让他不安。

examples.en: Don't perturb the sleeping cat.
examples.zh: 别打扰睡觉的猫。

definitions.en: n. a miniature model of something
definitions.zh: n. 小宇宙, 小世界, 人类

examples.en: The garden is a microcosm of nature.
examples.zh: 这个花园是大自然的缩影。

examples.en: This town is a microcosm of society.
examples.zh: 这个小镇是社会的缩影。

definitions.en: n. a compensating equivalent
definitions.zh: vt. 使平均, 使平衡, 使弥补
n. 平衡量, 平衡力, 势均力敌

examples.en: The weights counterbalance each other.
examples.zh: 这些砝码相互平衡。

examples.en: Her kindness is a counterbalance to his temper.
examples.zh: 她的善良是对他脾气的平衡。

definitions.en: n an architectural partition with a height and length greater than its thickness; used to divide or enclose an area or to support another structure
definitions.zh: n. 墙壁；墙体（wall的复数）

examples.en: The walls of the house are white.
examples.zh: 房子的墙壁是白色的。

examples.en: We painted the walls blue.
examples.zh: 我们把墙壁刷成了蓝色。

definitions.en: s. occurring or coming into existence after a person's death
definitions.zh: a. 遗腹的, 死后的
[医] 遗腹的

examples.en: He received a posthumous award.
examples.zh: 他死后获得了奖项。

examples.en: Her book was published posthumously.
examples.zh: 她的书在死后出版了。

definitions.en: s. based on sound reasoning or evidence
definitions.zh: a. 可守的, 站得住(脚)的, 合理的, 成立的

examples.en: His argument is not tenable in court.
examples.zh: 他的论点在法庭上站不住脚。

examples.en: The theory remains tenable after new evidence.
examples.zh: 这个理论在新证据后仍然成立。

definitions.en: v. be teeming, be abuzz
definitions.zh: vi. 充满, 充足, 倾注
vt. 倒出

examples.en: The river teems with fish.
examples.zh: 这条河里鱼很多。

examples.en: The market teems with shoppers on weekends.
examples.zh: 周末市场里挤满了购物者。

definitions.en: v. represent falsely
definitions.zh: vt. 不如实地叙述(或说明), 不称职地代表

examples.en: The article misrepresents the facts.
examples.zh: 这篇文章歪曲了事实。

examples.en: He misrepresented his qualifications on the form.
examples.zh: 他在表格上虚报了自己的资历。

definitions.en: a. of or located in the lower part of a town, or in the business center
definitions.zh: n. 市中心区

definitions.en: r. toward or in the lower or central part of town
definitions.zh: a. 市中心的
adv. 往闹市区

examples.en: We went downtown to shop.
examples.zh: 我们去市中心购物。

examples.en: The downtown area is very busy.
examples.zh: 市中心区域非常繁忙。

definitions.en: n. a heavy rain
definitions.zh: n. 倾盆大雨；注下

examples.en: We got caught in a sudden downpour.
examples.zh: 我们突然遇到了倾盆大雨。

examples.en: The downpour flooded the streets quickly.
examples.zh: 倾盆大雨很快淹没了街道。

definitions.en: v commit to memory; learn by heart
definitions.zh: vt. 记住, 熟记, 记录, 存储

examples.en: She tried to memorise the poem.
examples.zh: 她试图记住这首诗。

examples.en: You need to memorise these words.
examples.zh: 你需要记住这些单词。

definitions.en: v. invade in great numbers
definitions.zh: vt. 骚扰, 寄生于, 大批出没

definitions.en: v. live on or in a host, as of parasites
definitions.zh: [医] 传染, 感染

examples.en: Rats infest the old building.
examples.zh: 老鼠大批出没于旧楼。

examples.en: Parasites can infest the body.
examples.zh: 寄生虫可以寄生于人体。

definitions.en: a. exultantly proud and joyful; in high spirits
definitions.zh: a. 兴高采烈的

examples.en: She felt elated after winning the prize.
examples.zh: 获奖后她感到兴高采烈。

examples.en: The team was elated by the victory.
examples.zh: 团队因胜利而兴高采烈。

definitions.en: v. subject to prolonged examination, discussion, or deliberation
definitions.zh: vt. 使烦恼, 使苦恼
vi. 烦恼

examples.en: His constant questions vex me.
examples.zh: 他不断的问题使我烦恼。

examples.en: Don't vex your mother with noise.
examples.zh: 不要用噪音烦扰你的母亲。

definitions.en: s. unwillingness to do something contrary to your custom
definitions.zh: a. 不情愿的, 厌恶的

examples.en: He was loath to leave the party.
examples.zh: 他不情愿离开派对。

examples.en: She is loath to admit her mistake.
examples.zh: 她不愿承认自己的错误。

definitions.en: a. acceptable to the taste or mind
definitions.zh: a. 美味的, 好吃的, 可口的
[医] 适口的, 味美的

examples.en: The food was quite palatable.
examples.zh: 食物相当可口。

examples.en: She found the idea palatable.
examples.zh: 她觉得这个想法可以接受。

definitions.en: v. intrude in other people's affairs or business; interfere unwantedly
definitions.zh: vi. 干涉, 干预, 擅自摸弄
[法] 干预, 插手, 弄乱

examples.en: Don't meddle in other people's affairs.
examples.zh: 不要干涉别人的事情。

examples.en: She always meddles with my plans.
examples.zh: 她总是干预我的计划。

definitions.en: n. a restaurant where you serve yourself and pay a cashier
definitions.zh: n. 自助餐厅
[经] 自助餐厅

examples.en: We eat lunch in the school cafeteria.
examples.zh: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午餐。

examples.en: The cafeteria serves pizza and salad.
examples.zh: 自助餐厅供应披萨和沙拉。

definitions.en: n. a quality that arouses emotions (especially pity or sorrow)
definitions.zh: n. 伤感力, 感伤, 悲怅, 同情, 偶然因素, 哀婉动人的词句

examples.en: The story was full of pathos.
examples.zh: 故事充满了伤感。

examples.en: His speech had a tone of pathos.
examples.zh: 他的演讲带有悲怅的语气。

definitions.en: v. become wider
definitions.zh: vi. 扩大, 详述, 膨胀
vt. 使膨胀

examples.en: The pupils dilate in the dark.
examples.zh: 瞳孔在黑暗中会扩大。

examples.en: The doctor dilated the patient's eyes.
examples.zh: 医生扩大了病人的瞳孔。

definitions.en: s. lacking bodily or muscular strength or vitality
definitions.zh: a. 衰老的

examples.en: The old house looked decrepit and unsafe.
examples.zh: 老房子看起来衰老且不安全。

examples.en: A decrepit man walked slowly down the street.
examples.zh: 一个衰老的男人慢慢走在街上。

definitions.en: n. an aimless amble on a winding course
definitions.zh: n. 漫步, 随笔
vi. 漫步, 漫谈, 漫游, 蔓延
vt. 闲逛于

examples.en: We went for a ramble in the forest.
examples.zh: 我们去森林里漫步。

examples.en: He tends to ramble when he is nervous.
examples.zh: 他紧张时容易漫谈。

definitions.en: v. expose to the circulation of fresh air so as to retard spoilage
definitions.zh: vt. 使空气流通, 使通风, 公开讨论, 公开

definitions.en: v. circulate through and freshen
definitions.zh: [医] 通风, 换气

examples.en: Open the windows to ventilate the room.
examples.zh: 打开窗户让房间通风。

examples.en: They ventilate the issue in the meeting.
examples.zh: 他们在会议上公开讨论这个问题。

definitions.en: v. injure or wound seriously and leave permanent disfiguration or mutilation
definitions.zh: vt. 使残废, 使不能工作, 使伤残
[医] 伤残, 残废

examples.en: The accident could maim him for life.
examples.zh: 事故可能使他终身残废。

examples.en: The explosion maimed several soldiers.
examples.zh: 爆炸使几名士兵伤残。

definitions.en: a. open to two or more interpretations; or of uncertain nature or significance; or (often) intended to mislead
definitions.zh: a. 意义不明确的, 模棱两可的

definitions.en: s. open to question
definitions.zh: [医] 双关的, 两可的

examples.en: His answer was equivocal.
examples.zh: 他的回答模棱两可。

examples.en: She gave an equivocal response.
examples.zh: 她给出了一个含糊的回应。

definitions.en: v. cause to be more favorably inclined; gain the good will of
definitions.zh: vt. 使平静, 安慰, 绥靖, 使服从

examples.en: She tried to pacify the crying baby.
examples.zh: 她试图安抚哭泣的婴儿。

examples.en: The leader spoke to pacify the crowd.
examples.zh: 领导人讲话以安抚人群。

definitions.en: s. politely warm and friendly
definitions.zh: n. 兴奋剂, 补品

definitions.en: s. sincerely or intensely felt
definitions.zh: a. 热忱的, 诚恳的, 有兴奋作用的

examples.en: She gave us a cordial welcome.
examples.zh: 她热情地欢迎了我们。

examples.en: Their cordial relationship is admirable.
examples.zh: 他们热忱的关系令人钦佩。

definitions.en: v. be a part or attribute of
definitions.zh: vi. 从属于, 关于, 涉及, 附属, 适合, 相称
[法] 属于, 从属, 附属

examples.en: These rules pertain to all students.
examples.zh: 这些规则适用于所有学生。

examples.en: The documents pertain to the case.
examples.zh: 这些文件涉及该案件。

definitions.en: v. catch fire
definitions.zh: vt. 点燃, 使着火, 引起, 照亮

definitions.en: v. cause to start burning
definitions.zh: vi. 着火, 激动, 发亮

examples.en: She used a match to kindle the fire.
examples.zh: 她用火柴点燃了火。

examples.en: The story kindled his interest in history.
examples.zh: 这个故事引起了他对历史的兴趣。

definitions.en: v. separate (substances) into constituent elements or parts
definitions.zh: v. 分解, (使)腐烂

examples.en: Leaves decompose and enrich the soil.
examples.zh: 叶子腐烂并肥沃土壤。

examples.en: Scientists decompose the compound into elements.
examples.zh: 科学家将化合物分解成元素。

definitions.en: v. become tight or as if tight
definitions.zh: vt. 压缩, 束紧, 使收缩
vi. 收缩

examples.en: The snake will constrict its prey.
examples.zh: 蛇会收缩勒紧它的猎物。

examples.en: Tight clothes can constrict your movement.
examples.zh: 紧身衣服会束缚你的行动。

definitions.en: n. heavy pin having a head at one end and the other end being hammered flat after being passed through holes in the pieces that are fastened together
definitions.zh: n. 铆钉

definitions.en: v. fasten with a rivet or rivets
definitions.zh: vt. 用铆钉固定, 敲进去, 注目, 吸引住

examples.en: The story riveted the audience's attention.
examples.zh: 这个故事吸引了观众的注意力。

examples.en: He used a rivet to join the metal pieces.
examples.zh: 他用铆钉连接金属片。

definitions.en: n. hijacking on the high seas or in similar contexts; taking a ship or plane away from the control of those who are legally entitled to it
definitions.zh: n. 海盗行为, 海上劫掠, 剽窃, 著作权侵害, 非法翻印
[法] 海盗行为, 海上掠夺, 海盗罪

examples.en: Piracy is a serious crime at sea.
examples.zh: 海盗行为在海上是一种严重犯罪。

examples.en: Software piracy is illegal.
examples.zh: 软件盗版是非法的。

definitions.en: a good at remembering
definitions.zh: a. 紧握的, 固执的, 不屈不挠的, 黏着力强的

definitions.en: s stubbornly unyielding
definitions.zh: [医] 坚韧的

examples.en: She is a tenacious defender of her beliefs.
examples.zh: 她是自己信念的固执捍卫者。

examples.en: The dog had a tenacious grip on the bone.
examples.zh: 狗紧握着骨头不放。

definitions.en: v. act in disregard of laws, rules, contracts, or promises
definitions.zh: vt. 违反, 犯罪, 侵犯

definitions.en: v. spread over land, especially along a subsiding shoreline
definitions.zh: vi. 越界, 违法

examples.en: He transgressed the rules of the game.
examples.zh: 他违反了游戏规则。

examples.en: Do not transgress the boundaries of the park.
examples.zh: 不要越界进入公园范围。

definitions.en: v. satisfy (thirst)
definitions.zh: vt. 熄灭, 结束, 使冷却, 将...淬火

definitions.en: v. electronics: suppress (sparking) when the current is cut off in an inductive circuit, or suppress (an oscillation or discharge) in a component or device
definitions.zh: vi. 熄灭, 平息

examples.en: Water can quench your thirst quickly.
examples.zh: 水能迅速解渴。

examples.en: They tried to quench the fire with sand.
examples.zh: 他们试图用沙子灭火。

definitions.en: n. a long wandering and eventful journey
definitions.zh: n. 奥德赛(古希腊史诗)

examples.en: Her journey across Europe was an odyssey.
examples.zh: 她穿越欧洲的旅程是一次漫长的冒险。

examples.en: The explorer's odyssey lasted for years.
examples.zh: 探险家的奥德赛持续了多年。

definitions.en: n. an expression of sympathy with another's grief
definitions.zh: n. 哀悼, 吊唁

examples.en: We sent our condolences to the family.
examples.zh: 我们向家属表达了哀悼。

examples.en: He offered his condolences sincerely.
examples.zh: 他真诚地表示了吊唁。

definitions.en: n. a fictitious name used when the person performs a particular social role
definitions.zh: n. 假名, 笔名
[法] 笔名, 假名

examples.en: The author wrote under a pseudonym.
examples.zh: 那位作者用笔名写作。

examples.en: She chose a pseudonym for her blog.
examples.zh: 她为博客选了一个假名。

definitions.en: n. a stairway whose steps move continuously on a circulating belt

definitions.zh: 会计人员

examples.zh: 会计帮助处理税务。

examples.en: The company hired two new accountants.
examples.zh: 公司雇了两名新会计。

definitions.en: n something done (usually as opposed to something said)
definitions.zh: n. 动作；行动（action的复数）

examples.en: Your actions speak louder than words.
examples.zh: 你的行动胜于言语。

examples.en: He regretted his actions later.
examples.zh: 他后来后悔了自己的行为。

definitions.en: n any specific behavior
definitions.zh: n. （activity复数形式）活动；活动区；活动性

examples.en: We enjoy outdoor activities on weekends.
examples.zh: 我们周末喜欢户外活动。

examples.en: The school offers many activities for students.
examples.zh: 学校为学生提供许多活动。

definitions.en: n a fully developed person from maturity onward
definitions.zh: n. 成年人（adult的复数形式）

examples.zh: 成年人可以在选举中投票。

examples.en: Only adults are allowed to enter.
examples.zh: 只有成年人允许进入。

definitions.en: n the quality of having a superior or more favorable position
definitions.zh: n. 优势；特点；有利；[经] 利益（advantage的复数）

definitions.en: n (tennis) first point scored after deuce
definitions.zh: v. 促进（advantage的三单形式）；有利于

examples.en: This plan has many advantages.
examples.zh: 这个计划有很多优势。

examples.en: He listed the advantages of the job.
examples.zh: 他列出了这份工作的优点。

definitions.en: n a public promotion of some product or service
definitions.zh: n. [经] 广告（advertisement的复数）；宣传

examples.en: Advertisements are everywhere on the internet.
examples.zh: 广告在互联网上无处不在。

examples.en: She saw many advertisements for shoes.
examples.zh: 她看到了很多鞋子的广告。

definitions.en: n. transactions of professional or public interest
definitions.zh: n. 事务, 事宜；风流韵事

examples.en: He handles international affairs for the company.
examples.zh: 他负责公司的国际事务。

examples.en: She is busy with family affairs.
examples.zh: 她忙于家庭事务。

definitions.en: n an administrative unit of government
definitions.zh: n. 代理；代理处（agency的复数）

examples.en: Several agencies help find jobs.
examples.zh: 几家机构帮助找工作。

examples.en: Government agencies provide many services.
examples.zh: 政府机构提供许多服务。

definitions.en: n a living organism characterized by voluntary movement
definitions.zh: n. 动物, 动物世界；牲畜（animal的复数形式）

examples.en: Animals need food and water.
examples.zh: 动物需要食物和水。

examples.en: Many animals live in the forest.
examples.zh: 许多动物生活在森林里。

definitions.en: n a chemical substance derivable from a mold or bacterium that can kill microorganisms and cure bacterial infections
definitions.zh: n. 抗生学；抗生素

examples.en: Doctors prescribe antibiotics for infections.
examples.zh: 医生为感染开抗生素。

examples.en: Antibiotics can kill harmful bacteria.
examples.zh: 抗生素可以杀死有害细菌。

definitions.en: n any of various primates with short tails or no tail at all
definitions.zh: n. 猿( ape的名词复数 )

definitions.en: n someone who copies the words or behavior of another
definitions.zh: v. 模仿( ape的第三人称单数 )

examples.en: Apes are very intelligent animals.
examples.zh: 猿是非常聪明的动物。

examples.en: He studies how apes communicate.
examples.zh: 他研究猿如何交流。

definitions.en: n ideas or actions intended to deal with a problem or situation
definitions.zh: 处理

examples.en: We need new approaches to solve this.
examples.zh: 我们需要新的方法来解决这个问题。

examples.en: Different approaches work for different people.
examples.zh: 不同的方法对不同的人有效。

definitions.en: n. collection of records especially about an institution
definitions.zh: n. 档案, 档案室
[法] 公文档案, 案卷, 档案保管处

examples.en: The archives contain old documents.
examples.zh: 档案室保存着旧文件。

examples.en: She found the photo in the archives.
examples.zh: 她在档案中找到了那张照片。

definitions.en: n a particular geographical region of indefinite boundary (usually serving some special purpose or distinguished by its people or culture or geography)
definitions.zh: n. 区域, 领域；面积（area的复数形式）

examples.en: These areas are safe to visit.
examples.zh: 这些区域可以安全参观。

examples.en: We explored different areas of the city.
examples.zh: 我们探索了城市的不同区域。

definitions.en: n nonfictional prose forming an independent part of a publication
definitions.zh: n. 文章；冠词；物品；条款（article的复数）

examples.en: She writes articles for a magazine.
examples.zh: 她为一家杂志写文章。

examples.en: I read two interesting articles today.
examples.zh: 我今天读了两篇有趣的文章。

definitions.en: n a duty that you are assigned to perform (especially in the armed forces)
definitions.zh: n. 分配；作业（assignment的复数形式）

examples.en: The teacher gave us new assignments.
examples.zh: 老师给了我们新的作业。

examples.en: I finished all my assignments early.
examples.zh: 我早早完成了所有作业。

definitions.en: n (military) an offensive against an enemy (using weapons)
definitions.zh: n. 攻击, 评击（attack的复数形式）

examples.en: The army launched several attacks.
examples.zh: 军队发动了几次攻击。

examples.en: These attacks caused a lot of damage.
examples.zh: 这些攻击造成了很大破坏。

definitions.en: n earnest and conscientious activity intended to do or accomplish something
definitions.zh: n. 企图, 试图；尝试（attempt的复数）

definitions.en: n the act of attacking
definitions.zh: v. 试图；努力去做（attempt的三单形式）

examples.en: He made several attempts to call her.
examples.zh: 他尝试了几次给她打电话。

examples.en: All attempts to fix it failed.
examples.zh: 所有修复它的尝试都失败了。

definitions.en: n an unofficial association of people or groups
definitions.zh: n. 法官；乐队

examples.zh: 两支乐队在音乐节上表演。

examples.en: She loves listening to rock bands.
examples.zh: 她喜欢听摇滚乐队。

definitions.en: n a United States youth subculture of the 1950s; rejected possessions or regular work or traditional dress; for communal living and psychedelic drugs and anarchism; favored modern forms of jazz (e.g., bebop)
definitions.zh: n. 音乐节拍；差拍振动；心脏跳动（beat的复数）

examples.en: The music has a strong beat.
examples.zh: 这首音乐有很强的节拍。

examples.en: He tapped his foot to the beats.
examples.zh: 他随着节拍用脚打拍子。

definitions.en: n someone new to a field or activity
definitions.zh: n. 初学者；生手；首创者（beginner的复数）

examples.en: This class is for beginners only.
examples.zh: 这门课只针对初学者。

examples.en: Beginners should start with easy exercises.
examples.zh: 初学者应该从简单的练习开始。

definitions.en: n endless loop of flexible material between two rotating shafts or pulleys
definitions.zh: n. 带子；皮带（belt的复数）

examples.en: He wears leather belts to work.
examples.zh: 他上班时戴皮带。

examples.en: The belts on the machine are new.
examples.zh: 机器上的带子是新的。

definitions.en: n financial assistance in time of need
definitions.zh: n. 利益, 收益；福利, 效益（benefit的复数形式）

examples.en: Exercise has many health benefits.
examples.zh: 锻炼有很多健康益处。

examples.en: The job offers good benefits.
examples.zh: 这份工作提供很好的福利。

definitions.en: n a wheeled vehicle that has two wheels and is moved by foot pedals
definitions.zh: n. 自行车；脚踏车（bicycle的复数）

examples.en: Many people ride bicycles to work.
examples.zh: 很多人骑自行车上班。

examples.en: Bicycles are good for the environment.
examples.zh: 自行车对环境有益。

definitions.en: n a solid piece of something (usually having flat rectangular sides)
definitions.zh: n. 积木；黑金石；街区；[音]双头木鱼；楼群（block的复数）

examples.en: The child plays with wooden blocks.
examples.zh: 孩子玩木制积木。

examples.en: We walked three blocks to the store.
examples.zh: 我们走了三个街区到商店。

definitions.en: n. a percussion instrument consisting of a pair of hollow pieces of wood or bone (usually held between the thumb and fingers) that are made to click together (as by Spanish dancers) in rhythm with the dance
definitions.zh: n. 骨骼, 尸体

examples.en: Calcium is good for your bones.
examples.zh: 钙对你的骨骼有益。

examples.en: The dog buried the bones in the yard.
examples.zh: 狗把骨头埋在了院子里。

definitions.en: n a written work or composition that has been published (printed on pages bound together)
definitions.zh: n. 书评；书籍（book的复数）

examples.en: She reads many books every month.
examples.zh: 她每个月读很多书。

examples.en: These books are on the shelf.
examples.zh: 这些书在书架上。

definitions.en: n a bowling game played on a level lawn with biased wooden balls that are rolled at a jack
definitions.zh: n. 滚木球戏

examples.en: They played bowls in the park.
examples.zh: 他们在公园里玩滚木球戏。

examples.en: Bowls is a popular game in England.
examples.zh: 滚木球戏在英国很流行。

definitions.zh: 带来, 使掉头

examples.en: Hard work can bring about success.
examples.zh: 努力工作可以带来成功。

examples.en: The new law will bring about change.
examples.zh: 新法律将带来变化。

definitions.en: n a small book usually having a paper cover
definitions.zh: n. 小册子( brochure的名词复数 ); （某地、某旅馆等的）情况介绍手册; （印成小册子的）论文

examples.en: We picked up some travel brochures.
examples.zh: 我们拿了一些旅游手册。

examples.en: The brochures describe the hotel rooms.
examples.zh: 手册描述了酒店房间。

definitions.en: n a male with the same parents as someone else
definitions.zh: n. 哥们儿, 兄弟

examples.zh: 他有两个弟弟。

examples.en: My brothers and I play soccer together.
examples.zh: 我和兄弟们一起踢足球。

definitions.en: n a structure that has a roof and walls and stands more or less permanently in one place
definitions.zh: n. 建筑物（building的复数）

examples.zh: 这座城市有很多高楼。

examples.en: These buildings are very old.
examples.zh: 这些建筑非常古老。

definitions.en: n an enclosure made or wire or metal bars in which birds or animals can be kept
definitions.zh: n. 笼子( cage的名词复数 )

examples.zh: 鸟被关在笼子里。

examples.en: He cleaned the animal cages daily.
examples.zh: 他每天清理动物笼子。

definitions.en: n stick of wax with a wick in the middle
definitions.zh: n. 蜡烛, 烛台（candle复数形式）

examples.zh: 我们在蛋糕上点了蜡烛。

examples.en: The room was lit by candles.
examples.zh: 房间被蜡烛照亮。

definitions.en: n a game played with playing cards
definitions.zh: n. (playing cards)(正式)一副纸牌, 一副扑克牌, 纸牌游戏, 打扑克

examples.zh: 他们整晚打扑克牌。

examples.en: She shuffled the cards carefully.
examples.zh: 她仔细地洗了牌。

definitions.en: n events that provide the generative force that is the origin of something

examples.zh: 吸烟是肺癌的一个原因。

examples.zh: 我们需要找到问题的原因。

examples.zh: 熊有时在洞穴里睡觉。

examples.en: They explored the dark caves.
examples.zh: 他们探索了黑暗的洞穴。

definitions.en: n a compact disk that is used with a computer (rather than with an audio system); a large amount of digital information can be stored and accessed but it cannot be altered by the user

examples.zh: 软件以光盘形式提供。

examples.en: I inserted the CD-ROM into the drive.
examples.zh: 我把光盘插入驱动器。

definitions.en: n a document attesting to the truth of certain stated facts
definitions.zh: n. 证明书, 执照( certificate的名词复数 )

examples.zh: 她收到了毕业证书。

examples.en: We need to show our birth certificates.
examples.zh: 我们需要出示出生证明。

definitions.en: n an impetuous rush toward someone or something
definitions.zh: n. 费用；手续费；运费

examples.zh: 服务费非常高。

examples.zh: 他按时支付了所有费用。

definitions.en: a relatively low in price or charging low prices
definitions.zh: a. 成本更低, 比较便宜的

examples.zh: 这家店比那家便宜。

examples.en: We found a cheaper hotel nearby.
examples.zh: 我们在附近找到了一家更便宜的酒店。

definitions.en: n a written order directing a bank to pay money
definitions.zh: n. 支票；格（check的复数形式）

examples.zh: 她开了一张支票付房租。

examples.en: He deposited the checks at the bank.
examples.zh: 他把支票存入了银行。

definitions.en: n young bird especially of domestic fowl
definitions.zh: n. 雏鸡；小鸡（chick的复数形式）

examples.zh: 母鸡保护她的小鸡。

examples.zh: 小鸡是黄色毛茸茸的。

definitions.en: n the person or thing chosen or selected
definitions.zh: n. 选择（choice的复数）

examples.zh: 她在生活中做出了好的选择。

examples.en: We have many choices for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们晚餐有很多选择。

definitions.zh: n. 城市（city的复数）

examples.zh: 大城市有很多高楼大厦。

examples.en: I love visiting new cities around the world.
examples.zh: 我喜欢游览世界各地的新城市。

definitions.zh: n. （同班）同学( classmate的名词复数 ); 砚兄砚弟

examples.zh: 我的同学对我很友好。

examples.en: She studies with her classmates every day.
examples.zh: 她每天和同学们一起学习。

definitions.en: n a person who seeks the advice of a lawyer
definitions.zh: n. 客户端；顾客；救济对象；应受账款；委托方（client的复数）

examples.zh: 律师今天会见了他客户。

examples.en: Our clients are happy with the service.
examples.zh: 我们的客户对服务很满意。

examples.zh: 摄影师拍了一张花的特写镜头。

examples.en: A close-up shows every detail clearly.
examples.zh: 特写镜头清晰地显示每个细节。

definitions.zh: n. （扑克牌）梅花；俱乐部；社团（club的复数）

examples.en: He joined two clubs at school this year.
examples.zh: 他今年加入了学校的两个俱乐部。

examples.en: She plays the ace of clubs in cards.
examples.zh: 她打出了梅花A。

definitions.zh: n. 合作

examples.zh: 团队合作需要成员之间良好的合作。

examples.en: Their co-operation made the project successful.
examples.zh: 他们的合作使项目成功。

definitions.zh: a. 合作的；有协作精神的；愿意配合的; 齐心协力的；合作进行的
n. 合作社；合作机构

examples.en: The co-operative store sells local products.
examples.zh: 这家合作社商店出售当地产品。

examples.en: She is a very co-operative team member.
examples.zh: 她是一位非常愿意合作的团队成员。

definitions.en: n an associate that one works with
definitions.zh: n. 同事；同行（colleague的复数）

examples.zh: 我的同事帮我完成了报告。

examples.en: She enjoys working with her friendly colleagues.
examples.zh: 她喜欢和友好的同事们一起工作。

definitions.en: n the body of faculty and students of a college
definitions.zh: n. 专科学院（college复数形式）

examples.zh: 每年许多学生申请不同的学院。

examples.en: These colleges offer excellent science programs.
examples.zh: 这些学院提供优秀的科学课程。

definitions.en: n a commercially sponsored ad on radio or television
definitions.zh: n. （电台或电视播放的）广告 ( commercial的名词复数 ); 以大众欣赏为目的谱写的乐曲

examples.en: I saw many commercials during the football game.
examples.zh: 我在足球比赛中看到了很多广告。

examples.en: Commercials often try to sell new products.
examples.zh: 广告通常试图推销新产品。

definitions.en: n an institution created to conduct business
definitions.zh: n. 公司, 企业；公司财产；伙伴（company的复数形式）

examples.en: Many companies hire new workers every year.
examples.zh: 许多公司每年招聘新员工。

examples.en: These companies compete in the global market.
examples.zh: 这些公司在全球市场竞争。

definitions.en: n a machine for performing calculations automatically
definitions.zh: n. 计算机, 电脑（computer的复数）

examples.en: Computers help us work faster and better.
examples.zh: 电脑帮助我们更快更好地工作。

examples.en: Students use computers to do their homework.
examples.zh: 学生用电脑做作业。

definitions.en: n a contract granting the right to operate a subsidiary business
definitions.zh: n. （尤指由政府或雇主给予的）特许权( concession的名词复数 ); 承认; 减价; （在某地的）特许经营权

examples.en: The company made concessions to avoid a strike.
examples.zh: 公司做出让步以避免罢工。

examples.en: They offered concessions on the price of tickets.
examples.zh: 他们对票价提供了优惠。

definitions.en: n. the prevailing context that influences the performance or the outcome of a process
definitions.zh: n. 形势, 情况, 环境

examples.zh: 天气条件非常适合野餐。

examples.en: He agreed to help under certain conditions.
examples.zh: 他在某些条件下同意帮忙。

definitions.en: n close interaction
definitions.zh: n. 联系人；联络方式；触体（contact的复数形式）

examples.en: She has many useful contacts in the industry.
examples.zh: 她在行业中有很多有用的人脉。

examples.en: Please update your contacts in the phone book.
examples.zh: 请更新电话簿中的联系人。

definitions.en: n a substance that contaminates
definitions.zh: n. 污染物, 致污物( contaminant的名词复数 )

examples.en: The water contains harmful contaminants from factories.
examples.zh: 水中含有来自工厂的有害污染物。

examples.en: We must remove all contaminants from the food.
examples.zh: 我们必须去除食物中的所有污染物。

definitions.en: n. a list of divisions (chapters or articles) and the pages on which they start
definitions.zh: n. 目录

examples.zh: 目录列出了所有章节。

examples.en: Check the contents of the box carefully.
examples.zh: 仔细检查盒子里的内容。

definitions.en: n a binding agreement between two or more persons that is enforceable by law
definitions.zh: n. 契约( contract的名词复数 ); 婚约; [法律]契约法; 行贿

examples.zh: 双方昨天上午签署了合同。

examples.en: These contracts are valid for two years.
examples.zh: 这些合同有效期为两年。

definitions.en: n. pecuniary reimbursement to the winning party for the expenses of litigation
definitions.zh: n. 费用；诉讼费；损失（cost的复数）

examples.zh: 生活成本每年都在上涨。

examples.en: We need to reduce production costs immediately.
examples.zh: 我们需要立即降低生产成本。

definitions.en: n a politically organized body of people under a single government

examples.zh: 许多国家在气候变化问题上合作。

examples.en: She has visited several countries in Europe.
examples.zh: 她访问过欧洲的几个国家。

definitions.zh: [医] 分批出现(疹)

examples.zh: 农民每个季节种植不同的作物。

examples.en: The heavy rain damaged the crops this year.
examples.zh: 大雨损害了今年的庄稼。

definitions.en: n a small open container usually used for drinking; usually has a handle
definitions.zh: n. 拨火罐（器具）；杯子（cup的复数形式）

examples.en: Please put the cups on the table.
examples.zh: 请把杯子放在桌子上。

examples.en: She drank two cups of coffee this morning.
examples.zh: 她今天早上喝了两杯咖啡。

definitions.en: n hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window)
definitions.zh: n. [俚]灾难；窗帘（curtain的复数）

examples.en: She opened the curtains to let in sunlight.
examples.zh: 她拉开窗帘让阳光进来。

examples.en: The red curtains match the room's decor.
examples.zh: 红色窗帘与房间的装饰相配。

definitions.en: n someone who pays for goods or services
definitions.zh: n. 客户；顾客（customer的复数）

examples.en: The store treats its customers with respect.
examples.zh: 这家商店尊重它的顾客。

examples.en: Many customers complained about the poor service.
examples.zh: 许多顾客抱怨服务差。

definitions.en: n. a sum of money paid in compensation for loss or injury
definitions.zh: n. 赔偿金
[经] 损害赔偿; 伤害

examples.en: The court awarded damages to the victim.
examples.zh: 法院判给受害者赔偿金。

examples.en: He had to pay damages for the accident.
examples.zh: 他必须为事故支付赔偿金。

definitions.en: n something used to beautify
definitions.zh: n. 装修；装饰品（decoration的复数）

examples.en: We put up Christmas decorations in the house.
examples.zh: 我们在房子里挂上圣诞装饰品。

examples.en: The room's decorations are simple but elegant.
examples.zh: 房间的装饰简单而优雅。

definitions.en: n. true confidential information
definitions.zh: n. 详细资料；细节（detail的复数）

examples.en: Please provide more details about the plan.
examples.zh: 请提供关于计划的更多细节。

examples.en: She remembered every detail of the story.
examples.zh: 她记得故事的每一个细节。

definitions.en: n an effort that is inconvenient
definitions.zh: n. 困难( difficulty的名词复数 ); 难度; 难事; 麻烦

examples.en: He overcame many difficulties to finish the task.
examples.zh: 他克服了许多困难完成了任务。

examples.en: We face difficulties when learning a new language.
examples.zh: 学习新语言时我们会遇到困难。

definitions.en: n a document certifying the successful completion of a course of study
definitions.zh: pl. 公文, 文书, 执照, 特许证, 毕业文凭, 学位证书, 奖状

examples.en: Students receive diplomas after graduating from college.
examples.zh: 学生大学毕业后获得文凭。

examples.en: She hung her diplomas on the office wall.
examples.zh: 她把文凭挂在办公室墙上。

definitions.en: n an impairment of health or a condition of abnormal functioning
definitions.zh: n. 病害；疾病；疾病种类；病（disease的复数）

examples.en: Vaccines help prevent many serious diseases.
examples.zh: 疫苗有助于预防许多严重疾病。

examples.en: Clean water reduces the spread of diseases.
examples.zh: 干净的水减少疾病的传播。

definitions.en: n a piece of dishware normally used as a container for holding or serving food
definitions.zh: n. 餐具

examples.en: She washed all the dishes after dinner.
examples.zh: 她晚饭后洗了所有餐具。

examples.en: These dishes are made of fine china.
examples.zh: 这些盘子是细瓷做的。

definitions.en: n a disagreement or argument about something important
definitions.zh: n. 辩论( dispute的名词复数 ); 争端; （劳资）纠纷; 罢工

definitions.en: n coming into conflict with
definitions.zh: v. 辩论, 争论( dispute的第三人称单数 ); 争夺; 阻止; 就…进行辩论

examples.en: The two countries settled their border disputes peacefully.
examples.zh: 两国和平解决了边界争端。

examples.en: They had disputes over the project's budget.
examples.zh: 他们对项目预算有争议。

definitions.en: n a licensed medical practitioner
definitions.zh: n. 医生（doctor的复数）

examples.en: Doctors work hard to save patients' lives.
examples.zh: 医生努力拯救病人的生命。

examples.en: She visited two doctors for her back pain.
examples.zh: 她因背痛看了两位医生。

definitions.en: n writing that provides information (especially information of an official nature)
definitions.zh: n. 文档（document的复数形式）

examples.en: Please sign these documents before the meeting.
examples.zh: 请在会议前签署这些文件。

examples.en: He keeps important documents in a safe place.
examples.zh: 他把重要文件放在安全的地方。

definitions.en: n a voluntary gift (as of money or service or ideas) made to some worthwhile cause
definitions.zh: n. 捐款；捐赠（donation的复数）

examples.en: The charity received many donations from kind people.
examples.zh: 慈善机构收到了许多好心人的捐款。

examples.en: Donations help provide food for the homeless.
examples.zh: 捐款帮助为无家可归者提供食物。

definitions.en: n a swinging or sliding barrier that will close the entrance to a room or building or vehicle
definitions.zh: n. 大门；入口；通道（door的复数）

examples.en: Please close all doors before leaving the room.
examples.zh: 离开房间前请关上所有门。

examples.en: The front doors are made of strong wood.
examples.zh: 前门是用坚固的木头做的。

definitions.en: n a gully that is shallower than a ravine
definitions.zh: n. 铸件孔穴；图画（draw的复数）

examples.en: The artist draws beautiful pictures every day.
examples.zh: 这位艺术家每天画美丽的图画。

examples.en: She draws a map to show the way.
examples.zh: 她画了一张地图来指路。

definitions.en: n a single serving of a beverage
definitions.zh: n. 饮料, 饮品；喝酒（drink复数）

examples.en: We ordered cold drinks on a hot day.
examples.zh: 我们在热天点了冷饮。

examples.en: She brought drinks for everyone at the party.
examples.zh: 她为派对上的每个人带了饮料。

definitions.en: n a noticeable deterioration in performance or quality
definitions.zh: n. 下降, 减少

examples.en: There was a drop-off in sales this month.
examples.zh: 这个月销售额有所下降。

examples.en: The drop-off in quality surprised the manager.
examples.zh: 质量的下降让经理感到惊讶。

definitions.zh: [计] 漏失信息; 丢"1"

examples.en: The system had a drop-out error.
examples.zh: 系统出现了一个漏失信息错误。

examples.en: A drop-out caused data loss.
examples.zh: 一次漏失信息导致了数据丢失。

definitions.en: n a substance that is used as a medicine or narcotic
definitions.zh: n. 毒品, 药物

examples.en: The doctor prescribed some drugs.
examples.zh: 医生开了一些药物。

examples.en: He was arrested for selling drugs.
examples.zh: 他因贩卖毒品被捕。

definitions.en: n the social force that binds you to the courses of action demanded by that force; every opportunity, an obligation; every possession, a duty"- John D.Rockefeller Jr
definitions.zh: n. 关税（duty的复数）

examples.en: The duties on imports are high.
examples.zh: 进口关税很高。

examples.en: We must pay customs duties.
examples.zh: 我们必须支付海关关税。

definitions.en: n. property of a personal character that is portable but not used in business
definitions.zh: n. 财物, 个人财产
[经] 动产, 财物

examples.en: He left his personal effects at home.
examples.zh: 他把个人财物留在了家里。

examples.en: The effects were packed in boxes.
examples.zh: 这些财物被装在箱子里。

definitions.en: n. violent or severe weather (viewed as caused by the action of the four elements)
definitions.zh: n. 原理, 基础

examples.en: She learned the elements of math.
examples.zh: 她学习了数学的基础。

examples.en: The elements of cooking are simple.
examples.zh: 烹饪的基础很简单。

definitions.en: n (computer science) a system of world-wide electronic communication in which a computer user can compose a message at one terminal that can be regenerated at the recipient's terminal when the recipient logs in
definitions.zh: n. 电子信函

examples.en: I sent an email to my friend.
examples.zh: 我给朋友发了一封电子信函。

examples.en: Please check your email today.
examples.zh: 请今天查看你的电子信函。

definitions.en: n a sudden unforeseen crisis (usually involving danger) that requires immediate action
definitions.zh: n. 紧急需要；紧急事件

examples.en: Call 911 for emergencies.
examples.zh: 紧急事件请拨打911。

examples.en: We prepare for emergencies at work.
examples.zh: 我们在工作中为紧急事件做准备。

definitions.en: n a worker who is hired to perform a job
definitions.zh: n. 员工；雇员；从业人员（emploee的复数）

examples.en: The company has many employees.
examples.zh: 这家公司有很多员工。

examples.en: Employees work hard every day.
examples.zh: 员工们每天努力工作。

definitions.en: n (physics) a thermodynamic quantity equivalent to the capacity of a physical system to do work; the units of energy are joules or ergs
definitions.zh: n. 活力( energy的名词复数 ); [物理学]（原子、电、辐射的）能; [常用复数]精力; （有效地发挥的）力量

examples.en: She put all her energies into work.
examples.zh: 她把所有精力都投入工作。

examples.en: Renewable energies are important.
examples.zh: 可再生能源很重要。

definitions.en: n a person who uses scientific knowledge to solve practical problems
definitions.zh: n. 工程师；机械师（engineer的复数）

examples.en: The engineers designed a new bridge.
examples.zh: 工程师们设计了一座新桥。

examples.en: Many engineers work on this project.
examples.zh: 许多工程师在这个项目上工作。

definitions.en: n an item of information that is typical of a class or group
definitions.zh: n. 例子；列证（example的复数形式）

examples.en: The teacher gave clear examples.
examples.zh: 老师给出了清晰的例子。

examples.en: These examples help me understand.
examples.zh: 这些例子帮助我理解。

definitions.en: n a set of questions or exercises evaluating skill or knowledge
definitions.zh: n. 考试；检查（exam的复数）

examples.en: Students study hard for exams.
examples.zh: 学生们为考试努力学习。

examples.en: The exams are next week.
examples.zh: 考试在下周。

definitions.en: v. fill with sublime emotion
definitions.zh: vt. 使高兴, 使愉快, 鼓励

examples.en: The good news exhilarated everyone.
examples.zh: 好消息使每个人高兴。

examples.en: A walk in nature can exhilarate you.
examples.zh: 在大自然中散步能让你愉快。

definitions.en: n amounts paid for goods and services that may be currently tax deductible (as opposed to capital expenditures)
definitions.zh: n. 开支, 经费, 费用

definitions.en: n a detriment or sacrifice
definitions.zh: [法] 开支, 支出, 经费

examples.en: We need to cut our expenses.
examples.zh: 我们需要削减开支。

examples.en: Travel expenses are high this month.
examples.zh: 这个月的旅行费用很高。

definitions.en: n the act of conducting a controlled test or investigation
definitions.zh: n. 实验( experiment的名词复数 ); 试验; 尝试; 实践

examples.en: They conduct experiments in the lab.
examples.zh: 他们在实验室进行实验。

examples.en: The experiments gave good results.
examples.zh: 这些实验给出了好的结果。

definitions.en: n a building or place that provides a particular service or is used for a particular industry
definitions.zh: n. 工具, 设施, 设备

examples.en: The school has modern facilities.
examples.zh: 学校有现代化的设施。

examples.en: Public facilities are well maintained.
examples.zh: 公共设施维护得很好。

definitions.en: n a plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing
definitions.zh: n. 工厂, 车厂（factory复数形式）

examples.en: Many factories produce cars here.
examples.zh: 许多工厂在这里生产汽车。

examples.en: The factories are near the river.
examples.zh: 这些工厂在河边附近。

definitions.en: n anything that contributes causally to a result
definitions.zh: n. 因素（factor的复数）

examples.en: Several factors affect the weather.
examples.zh: 几个因素影响天气。

examples.en: Cost is an important factor.
examples.zh: 成本是一个重要因素。

definitions.en: n diurnal birds of prey having long pointed powerful wings adapted for swift flight
definitions.zh: n. 猎鹰；隼鹰队；猎鹰导弹（falcon的复数形式）

examples.en: Falcons are fast birds of prey.
examples.zh: 猎鹰是快速的猛禽。

examples.en: We saw falcons flying high.
examples.zh: 我们看到猎鹰高高飞翔。

definitions.en: n a social unit living together
definitions.zh: n. 家族；家庭（family的复数）

examples.en: All families need love and support.
examples.zh: 所有家庭都需要爱和支持。

examples.en: Many families live in this town.
examples.zh: 许多家庭住在这个镇上。

definitions.en: n a person who operates a farm
definitions.zh: n. 农民（farmer的复数）

examples.en: Farmers grow food for everyone.
examples.zh: 农民为大家种植食物。

examples.en: The farmers work in the fields.
examples.zh: 农民们在田里工作。

definitions.en: n workplace consisting of farm buildings and cultivated land as a unit
definitions.zh: n. 农场；庄园（farm的复数形式）

examples.en: There are many farms in the area.
examples.zh: 这个地区有很多农场。

examples.en: The farms produce fresh vegetables.
examples.zh: 这些农场生产新鲜蔬菜。

definitions.en: n a prominent attribute or aspect of something
definitions.zh: n. 容貌；产品特点, 特征；嘴脸（feature的复数）

examples.en: The phone has many useful features.
examples.zh: 这款手机有很多有用的特点。

examples.en: Her features are very beautiful.
examples.zh: 她的容貌非常美丽。

definitions.en: n a fixed charge for a privilege or for professional services
definitions.zh: n. 规费；费用（fee的复数）

examples.en: The school fees are due next month.
examples.zh: 学校费用下个月到期。

examples.en: We paid the registration fees.
examples.zh: 我们支付了注册费。

definitions.en: n the part of the leg of a human being below the ankle joint
definitions.zh: pl. 脚

definitions.en: n a linear unit of length equal to 12 inches or a third of a yard
definitions.zh: n. 尺

examples.en: He hurt his feet while running.
examples.zh: 他跑步时伤了脚。

examples.en: The table is three feet long.
examples.zh: 这张桌子有三英尺长。

definitions.en: n a boat that transports people or vehicles across a body of water and operates on a regular schedule
definitions.zh: n. 渡船( ferry的名词复数 ); 渡口; 摆渡; 飞机渡运

definitions.en: n transport by boat or aircraft
definitions.zh: v. 运送( ferry的第三人称单数 ); （乘渡船）渡过（河等）; 渡运飞机; 摆渡, 用（渡）船渡, （船）来往行驶

examples.en: The ferries cross the river daily.
examples.zh: 渡船每天过河。

examples.en: We took one of the ferries.
examples.zh: 我们乘坐了其中一艘渡船。

definitions.en: n a diagram or picture illustrating textual material
definitions.zh: n. 图形, 图表；价格, 金额, 数字；规定动作；人物（figure的复数）

examples.en: The figures show a big increase.
examples.zh: 这些图表显示大幅增长。

examples.en: Please check the sales figures.
examples.zh: 请检查销售数字。

definitions.en: n any of the terminal members of the hand (sometimes excepting the thumb)
definitions.zh: n. 梳状剔除器；手指头, 指头（finger复数）

examples.en: She has long, slender fingers.
examples.zh: 她有修长的手指。

examples.en: He counted on his fingers.
examples.zh: 他用手指计数。

definitions.en: n the members of a business organization that owns or operates one or more establishments
definitions.zh: n. 公司, 厂商（firm的复数）

examples.en: Several firms compete for the contract.
examples.zh: 几家公司竞争这份合同。

examples.en: The firms are located downtown.
examples.zh: 这些公司位于市中心。

definitions.zh: a. 急救的

examples.en: She took a first-aid course.
examples.zh: 她上了急救课程。

examples.en: A first-aid kit is essential.
examples.zh: 急救箱是必需的。

definitions.en: n. footwear (shoes or slippers) with no heel (or a very low heel)
definitions.zh: n. 平原, 扁钢；低沼泽（flat的复数形式）

examples.en: They live in a block of flats.
examples.zh: 他们住在一栋公寓楼里。

examples.en: She prefers wearing flats to heels.
examples.zh: 她更喜欢穿平底鞋而不是高跟鞋。

definitions.en: n the inside lower horizontal surface (as of a room, hallway, tent, or other structure)
definitions.zh: n. 楼地面；地板；楼层；层数（floor的复数）

examples.en: The building has ten floors.
examples.zh: 这栋楼有十层。

examples.en: Please mop the floors today.
examples.zh: 请今天拖地板。

definitions.zh: n. 繁荣

examples.en: The city saw great flourishment.
examples.zh: 这座城市经历了巨大的繁荣。

examples.en: Flourishment came after the reforms.
examples.zh: 改革之后出现了繁荣。

definitions.en: n the phonological or orthographic sound or appearance of a word that can be used to describe or identify something
definitions.zh: n. 窗体；表单；表格（form的复数形式）

examples.en: Please fill out these forms.
examples.zh: 请填写这些表格。

examples.en: Different forms of art exist.
examples.zh: 存在不同形式的艺术。

definitions.en: n someone whose style is out of fashion
definitions.zh: n. 化石( fossil的名词复数 ); 老顽固; 食古不化的人; 老古董（老人）

examples.en: They found fossils in the rock.
examples.zh: 他们在岩石中发现了化石。

examples.en: These fossils are millions of years old.
examples.zh: 这些化石有数百万年历史。

definitions.en: a. for the entire time appropriate to an activity
definitions.zh: a. 全部时间的, 专任的

examples.en: She works full-time at the bank.
examples.zh: 她在银行全职工作。

examples.en: He is a full-time student.
examples.zh: 他是一名全职学生。

definitions.en: -ing form of fund-raise
definitions.zh: (fund-raise 的现在分词) 募金

examples.en: They organized a fund-raising event.
examples.zh: 他们组织了一次募金活动。

examples.en: Fund-raising helps the charity.
examples.zh: 募金帮助慈善机构。

definitions.en: n the state of affairs that a plan is intended to achieve and that (when achieved) terminates behavior intended to achieve it
definitions.zh: n. 目标, 目的；进球, 射中次数

examples.en: Set clear goals for yourself.
examples.zh: 为自己设定明确的目标。

examples.en: The team scored three goals.
examples.zh: 球队进了三个球。

definitions.en: n the organization that is the governing authority of a political unit
definitions.zh: n. 政权；政府；可转让政府证券（government的复数）

examples.en: Different governments have different laws.
examples.zh: 不同的政府有不同的法律。

examples.en: Governments work for the people.
examples.zh: 政府为人民服务。

definitions.en: n a person who has received a degree from a school (high school or college or university)
definitions.zh: n. <美>毕业生( graduate的名词复数 ); <英>大学毕业生; （已经取得学士学位正在攻读高级学位的）研究生; 量筒

definitions.en: n a measuring instrument for measuring fluid volume; a glass container (cup or cylinder or flask) whose sides are marked with or divided into amounts
definitions.zh: v. 渐变( graduate的第三人称单数 ); 渐渐变为（与into连用）; 渐渐消逝（与away连用）; 取得资格（与as连用）

examples.en: The graduates celebrated their success.
examples.zh: 毕业生们庆祝他们的成功。

examples.en: Many graduates find good jobs.
examples.zh: 许多毕业生找到好工作。

definitions.en: n any monetary aid
definitions.zh: [经] 补助金, 拨款, 津贴

examples.en: The university offers research grants.
examples.zh: 大学提供研究补助金。

examples.en: She applied for several educational grants.
examples.zh: 她申请了几项教育拨款。

definitions.en: n any number of entities (members) considered as a unit
definitions.zh: n. 群组, 组；用户组；团体（group的复数形式）

examples.en: Students work in small groups.
examples.zh: 学生们以小组形式工作。

examples.en: There are two main groups.
examples.zh: 有两个主要团体。

definitions.en: n a visitor to whom hospitality is extended
definitions.zh: n. 客人；来宾（guest的复数）

examples.en: We invited many guests to the party.
examples.zh: 我们邀请了许多客人参加聚会。

examples.en: The guests arrived early.
examples.zh: 客人们早到了。

definitions.en: n an established custom
definitions.zh: n. 习性；习惯（habit的复数）

examples.en: Good habits help you succeed in life.
examples.zh: 好习惯有助于你在生活中成功。

examples.en: She changed her eating habits last year.
examples.zh: 她去年改变了饮食习惯。

definitions.en: -ing form of hard-work
definitions.zh: (hard-work 的现在分词) 努力工作；[劳经] 繁重的工作

examples.en: She is a hard-working student in class.
examples.zh: 她在班上是个勤奋的学生。

examples.en: Hard-working people often achieve their goals.
examples.zh: 勤奋的人通常能实现目标。

definitions.en: n headdress that protects the head from bad weather; has shaped crown and usually a brim
definitions.zh: abbr. 转换终端应用程序（Host Access Transformation Services）

examples.en: We wear hats to protect from the sun.
examples.zh: 我们戴帽子防晒。

examples.en: Those hats are very colorful and pretty.
examples.zh: 那些帽子色彩鲜艳又漂亮。

definitions.en: n adult female chicken
definitions.zh: n. 母鸡( hen的名词复数 ); 雌禽

examples.en: The hens lay eggs every morning.
examples.zh: 母鸡每天早上都下蛋。

examples.en: We have ten hens on our farm.
examples.zh: 我们的农场有十只母鸡。

definitions.en: n. tower consisting of a multistoried building of offices or apartments
definitions.zh: a. 有多层的, 高楼的

definitions.en: a. used of buildings of many stories equipped with elevators; tall
definitions.zh: n. 高楼, 大厦

examples.zh: 他们住在市中心的高层建筑里。

examples.en: The city has many high-rise apartments.
examples.zh: 这座城市有许多高层公寓。

definitions.en: n an indirect suggestion
definitions.zh: n. 暗示, 提示（hint的复数形式）

examples.zh: 老师给了我们考试的有用提示。

examples.zh: 她暗示了关于生日礼物的想法。

definitions.en: n (baseball) a successful stroke in an athletic contest (especially in baseball)

examples.zh: 这首歌成了最热门的歌曲之一。

examples.en: He hits the ball very hard in baseball.
examples.zh: 他在棒球中击球非常用力。

definitions.en: n an auxiliary activity
definitions.zh: n. 嗜好；兴趣爱好；燕隼；[英方]小马（hobby的复数）

examples.zh: 阅读和绘画是我最喜欢的爱好。

examples.en: She has many hobbies like swimming and dancing.
examples.zh: 她有很多爱好，比如游泳和跳舞。

definitions.en: n solid-hoofed herbivorous quadruped domesticated since prehistoric times
definitions.zh: n. 马；马匹（horse的复数形式）

examples.en: The horses run fast across the field.
examples.zh: 马儿在田野上快速奔跑。

examples.en: We saw many horses at the farm.
examples.zh: 我们在农场看到了许多马。

definitions.en: n a social unit living together
definitions.zh: n. 同住在一所房子里的人, 一家人, 户( household的名词复数 )

examples.zh: 许多家庭每周回收垃圾。

examples.en: The survey studied thousands of households.
examples.zh: 这项调查研究了数千个家庭。

definitions.en: n all of the living human inhabitants of the earth
definitions.zh: n. 人类（human的复数形式）

examples.en: Humans need food and water to survive.
examples.zh: 人类需要食物和水才能生存。

examples.en: All humans share the same basic needs.
examples.zh: 所有人类都有相同的基本需求。

definitions.en: n the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about
definitions.zh: abbr. 工业设计优秀奖

examples.zh: 她与小组分享了她的想法。

examples.en: Good ideas can change the world.
examples.zh: 好主意可以改变世界。

definitions.en: n the distinct personality of an individual regarded as a persisting entity
definitions.zh: n. 身份( identity的名词复数 ); 同一性; 个性; 同一人

examples.zh: 我们需要保护我们的在线身份。

examples.en: Their identities were kept secret for safety.
examples.zh: 为了安全，他们的身份被保密。

definitions.en: n commodities (goods or services) bought from a foreign country
definitions.zh: n. 进口商品；进口总额（import的复数）

examples.en: The country buys many imports from abroad.
examples.zh: 这个国家从国外购买许多进口商品。

examples.en: Imports of electronics have increased this year.
examples.zh: 今年电子产品的进口增加了。

definitions.en: n a search for knowledge
definitions.zh: n. 调查( inquiry的名词复数 ); 疑问; 探究; 打听

examples.zh: 请将所有询问直接提交到办公室。

examples.en: We received many inquiries about the product.
examples.zh: 我们收到了许多关于该产品的询问。

definitions.en: n small air-breathing arthropod
definitions.zh: n. 昆虫；昆虫类, 昆虫纲（insect的复数形式）

examples.zh: 像蜜蜂这样的昆虫帮助花朵授粉。

examples.en: Some insects are harmful to crops.
examples.zh: 有些昆虫对庄稼有害。

definitions.en: n an association organized to promote art or science or education
definitions.zh: n. 学院（institute的复数）

examples.zh: 许多研究机构研究气候变化。

examples.en: The institute offers courses in science.
examples.zh: 该学院提供科学课程。

definitions.en: n an organization founded and united for a specific purpose
definitions.zh: n. 体系

examples.zh: 银行是重要的金融机构。

examples.en: Educational institutions help students learn.
examples.zh: 教育机构帮助学生学习。

definitions.en: n a person whose occupation is teaching
definitions.zh: n. 指导者, 教师( instructor的名词复数 )

examples.zh: 指导老师非常乐于助人且有耐心。

examples.en: Our instructors teach us new skills every day.
examples.zh: 我们的指导老师每天教我们新技能。

definitions.en: n a device that requires skill for proper use
definitions.zh: n. 乐器；工具；仪器（instrument的复数）

examples.en: She plays several musical instruments beautifully.
examples.zh: 她优美地演奏几种乐器。

examples.en: The doctor used special instruments for surgery.
examples.zh: 医生使用特殊仪器进行手术。

definitions.en: n the questioning of a person (or a conversation in which information is elicited); often conducted by journalists
definitions.zh: n. 接见( interview的名词复数 ); 采访; 面谈; 会谈

definitions.en: n a conference (usually with someone important)
definitions.zh: v. 面试( interview的第三人称单数 ); 访问; 会见; （私下）提问

examples.zh: 他下周有两个工作面试。

examples.en: The interviews with the candidates went well.
examples.zh: 与候选人的面试进行得很顺利。

definitions.en: n a scientist who devotes himself to doing research
definitions.zh: n. 调查者, 审查者( investigator的名词复数 )

examples.zh: 调查人员正在调查这个案件。

examples.en: Police investigators found important clues.
examples.zh: 警方调查人员找到了重要线索。

definitions.en: v. watch over (students taking an exam, to prevent cheating)
definitions.zh: vi. 看守, 监考

examples.zh: 老师将监考。

examples.en: She was asked to invigilate the test.
examples.zh: 她被要求监考。

definitions.en: n an important question that is in dispute and must be settled
definitions.zh: n. 议题, 问题；争点；债券（issue的复数）

examples.zh: 我们需要讨论这些重要问题。

examples.en: Environmental issues affect everyone on Earth.
examples.zh: 环境问题影响地球上的每个人。

definitions.en: n a distinct part that can be specified separately in a group of things that could be enumerated on a list
definitions.zh: n. 项目；名目；所有物品（item的复数形式）

examples.zh: 请检查购物清单上的所有物品。

examples.en: The store sells many different items.
examples.zh: 这家商店出售许多不同的商品。

definitions.en: n the principal activity in your life that you do to earn money
definitions.zh: n. 工作（job的复数形式）

examples.zh: 许多人正在寻找新工作。

examples.en: She has two part-time jobs this summer.
examples.zh: 她今年夏天有两份兼职工作。

definitions.zh: n. 关键字

examples.zh: 使用关键词在线搜索信息。

examples.zh: 文章包含搜索引擎优化的重要关键词。

definitions.en: n a young person of either sex
definitions.zh: n. 小山羊；儿童（kid的复数）

examples.zh: 孩子们在公园里玩耍。

examples.en: She teaches kids how to read.
examples.zh: 她教孩子们如何阅读。

definitions.en: n one thousand grams; the basic unit of mass adopted under the Systeme International d'Unites
definitions.zh: n. 千克( kilogram的名词复数 )

examples.zh: 这个包重五公斤。

examples.en: She bought two kilograms of apples.
examples.zh: 她买了两公斤苹果。

definitions.en: n a case for containing a set of articles
definitions.zh: n. 装备；小桶；锦囊（kit的复数）

examples.en: We bought model kits for the children.
examples.zh: 我们给孩子们买了模型套件。

definitions.en: n a body of (usually fresh) water surrounded by land
definitions.zh: n. 色淀；湖泊, 湖畔

examples.zh: 这个地区有许多美丽的湖泊。

examples.en: We went swimming in the lakes last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们去湖里游泳了。

definitions.en: n. the most recent news or development
definitions.zh: a. 最近的

examples.zh: 你听说最新消息了吗？

examples.en: She always wears the latest fashion.
examples.zh: 她总是穿最新潮的时装。

definitions.en: n a unit of instruction
definitions.zh: n. 功课( lesson的名词复数 ); 课程; 教训; 一堂课

examples.en: I have piano lessons every Tuesday.
examples.zh: 我每周二上钢琴课。

examples.en: We learned valuable lessons from the experience.
examples.zh: 我们从这次经历中学到了宝贵的教训。

definitions.en: n a position on a scale of intensity or amount or quality

examples.zh: 水位正在快速上升。

examples.en: She reached high levels of success.
examples.zh: 她达到了很高的成功水平。

examples.zh: 公共图书馆向所有人提供免费书籍。

examples.en: She spends weekends studying in libraries.
examples.zh: 她周末在图书馆学习。

definitions.en: n (physics) electromagnetic radiation that can produce a visual sensation
definitions.zh: n. （供食用的）家畜的肺脏；灯光（light的复数）

examples.zh: 离开时关灯。

examples.en: The city lights look beautiful at night.
examples.zh: 城市的灯光在夜晚看起来很美丽。

definitions.en: n large gregarious predatory feline of Africa and India having a tawny coat with a shaggy mane in the male

examples.zh: 狮子被称为丛林之王。

examples.en: We saw lions at the zoo yesterday.
examples.zh: 我们昨天在动物园看到了狮子。

definitions.en: n the temporary provision of money (usually at interest)
definitions.zh: n. 借贷；贷款（loan的复数形式）

examples.zh: 银行提供贷款购买房屋。

examples.en: She took out student loans for college.
examples.zh: 她为上大学申请了学生贷款。

definitions.zh: n. 位置；定位件；地点（location的复数）

examples.zh: 这项投资被认为是低风险的。

examples.en: Doctors recommend low-risk exercises for beginners.
examples.zh: 医生推荐初学者进行低风险运动。

definitions.en: n any mechanical or electrical device that transmits or modifies energy to perform or assist in the performance of human tasks
definitions.zh: n. 机器；机械（machine的复数）

examples.zh: 现代机器使工作容易得多。

examples.en: The factory uses many different machines.
examples.zh: 工厂使用许多不同的机器。

definitions.en: n the bags of letters and packages that are transported by the postal service
definitions.zh: n. 邮件（mail的复数形式）

examples.zh: 这些材料非常坚固。

examples.en: She prepares healthy meals for us.

examples.zh: 我们使用不同的方法解决问题。

examples.en: These methods are very effective.
examples.zh: 这些方法非常有效。

examples.zh: 我们在上午十点左右休息一下。

examples.zh: 会议记录得到了所有人的批准。

examples.zh: 我们周末看电影。

examples.en: She loves watching action movies.
examples.zh: 她喜欢看动作电影。

definitions.en: n one of the contractile organs of the body
definitions.zh: n. 肌肉（muscle的复数）

examples.en: His muscles are very toned.

examples.zh: 他们庆祝不同民族的节日。

examples.zh: 渔夫用网捕鱼。

examples.zh: 我们架设网来保护花园。

examples.zh: 他每天早上看报纸。

examples.en: Newspapers provide news from around the world.
examples.zh: 报纸提供世界各地的新闻。

definitions.zh: n. 不喝酒的人, 戒酒的人

examples.zh: 他不喝酒，更喜欢果汁。

examples.en: As a non-drinker, she feels healthy.
examples.zh: 作为不喝酒的人，她感觉很健康。

examples.zh: 她在讲座期间做笔记。

examples.zh: 老师用高架投影仪上课。

examples.en: OHP stands for overhead projection.
examples.zh: OHP代表高架发射。

examples.zh: 这次考试是开卷的。

examples.en: An open-book test allows reference materials.
examples.zh: 开卷考试允许参考材料。

definitions.zh: n. 机会( opportunity的名词复数 ); 适当的时机; 条件; 就业（或晋升、进步等）的良机

examples.zh: 有很多学习的机会。

examples.en: She looks for new opportunities every day.
examples.zh: 她每天寻找新的机会。

examples.zh: 这本书有三百页。
