examples.zh: 这些政党有不同的观点。

definitions.en: n a traveler riding in a vehicle (a boat or bus or car or plane or train etc) who is not operating it
definitions.zh: n. 乘客( passenger的名词复数 ); 旅客; 白吃饭的人; 闲散人员

examples.en: The bus carries many passengers daily.
examples.zh: 这辆公交车每天载很多乘客。

examples.en: Passengers must fasten their seat belts.
examples.zh: 乘客必须系好安全带。

definitions.en: n a person who requires medical care
definitions.zh: n. 病人（patient的复数形式）

examples.en: The doctor treats many patients every day.
examples.zh: 医生每天治疗许多病人。

examples.en: Patients wait in the clinic room.
examples.zh: 病人在诊所里等候。

definitions.en: n a perceptual structure
definitions.zh: n. 模式（pattern的复数形式）

examples.en: These patterns repeat on the fabric.
examples.zh: 这些图案在布料上重复。

examples.en: We study weather patterns carefully.
examples.zh: 我们仔细研究天气模式。

definitions.en: n a country person
definitions.zh: n. 农民( peasant的名词复数 ); 农夫; 佃农; 粗俗的人

examples.en: The peasants work in the fields.
examples.zh: 农民们在田里劳作。

examples.en: Many peasants live in rural areas.
examples.zh: 许多农民住在农村地区。

definitions.en: n a fractional monetary unit of Ireland and the United Kingdom; equal to one hundredth of a pound
definitions.zh: pl. (非正式)copper便士, (美)分, 分币

examples.en: He saved a few pennies in his jar.
examples.zh: 他在罐子里存了几便士。

examples.en: Pennies are small coins worth little.
examples.zh: 便士是小面值硬币。

definitions.en: n a domesticated animal kept for companionship or amusement
definitions.zh: abbr. 公共英语等级考试（Public English Tset System）

examples.en: She passed the PETS exam last year.
examples.zh: 她去年通过了公共英语等级考试。

examples.en: PETS helps improve English skills.
examples.zh: 公共英语等级考试有助于提高英语技能。

definitions.en: n. a program in which the audience participates by telephone
definitions.zh: n. 观众/听众通过电话参与讨论或提问的电视节目/广播节目

examples.en: The radio show has a phone-in segment.
examples.zh: 这个广播节目有听众电话参与环节。

examples.en: Listeners call during the phone-in program.
examples.zh: 听众在电话参与节目中打电话。

definitions.en: n a photographic copy of written or printed or graphic work
definitions.zh: n. 影印本( photocopy的名词复数 ); 复印件

examples.en: Make photocopies of these documents.
examples.zh: 复印这些文件。

examples.en: She keeps photocopies for her records.
examples.zh: 她保留复印件作为记录。

definitions.en: n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
definitions.zh: n. 照片；逼真的描绘（photograph的复数）

examples.en: She takes photographs of beautiful scenery.
examples.zh: 她拍摄美丽风景的照片。

examples.en: These photographs remind me of home.
examples.zh: 这些照片让我想起家。

definitions.en: n a representation of a person or scene in the form of a print or transparent slide; recorded by a camera on light-sensitive material
definitions.zh: n. 照片, 图片；相册（photo的复数形式）

examples.en: He shared his vacation photos online.
examples.zh: 他在网上分享了度假照片。

examples.en: The photos are stored in an album.
examples.zh: 这些照片存放在相册里。

definitions.en: n a visual representation (of an object or scene or person or abstraction) produced on a surface
definitions.zh: n. 电影院

examples.en: We go to the pictures on Friday.
examples.zh: 我们周五去电影院。

examples.en: The pictures show beautiful landscapes.
examples.zh: 这些图片展示了美丽的风景。

definitions.en: n something that resembles a tablet of medicine in shape or size
definitions.zh: n. 丸剂；药丸（pill的复数）

examples.en: Take these pills after meals.
examples.zh: 饭后服用这些药丸。

examples.en: The doctor prescribed some pills for pain.
examples.zh: 医生开了一些止痛药丸。

definitions.en: n a point located with respect to surface features of some region
definitions.zh: n. 地点；位置；[数]位数（place的复数）

examples.en: We visited many interesting places last summer.
examples.zh: 去年夏天我们参观了许多有趣的地方。

examples.en: These places are popular with tourists.
examples.zh: 这些地方很受游客欢迎。

definitions.en: n a person who makes plans
definitions.zh: n. 规划者, 策划人( planner的名词复数 )

examples.en: The planners designed a new park.
examples.zh: 规划者设计了一个新公园。

examples.en: Urban planners consider many factors.
examples.zh: 城市规划者考虑许多因素。

definitions.en: n buildings for carrying on industrial labor
definitions.zh: n. 植物；工厂（plant的复数形式）

examples.en: These plants need more sunlight to grow.
examples.zh: 这些植物需要更多阳光才能生长。

examples.en: The car factory has two large plants.
examples.zh: 这家汽车厂有两个大工厂。

definitions.en: n the particular portion of space occupied by something
definitions.zh: n. 定位；位置（position的复数）

examples.en: We changed our positions in the room.
examples.zh: 我们改变了在房间里的位置。

examples.en: She applied for two different positions.
examples.zh: 她申请了两个不同的职位。

definitions.en: n 16 ounces avoirdupois
definitions.zh: n. 磅, 英镑；重击（pound复数形式）

examples.en: The bag weighs ten pounds.
examples.zh: 这个袋子重十磅。

examples.en: He paid fifty pounds for the book.
examples.zh: 他付了五十英镑买这本书。

definitions.en: n a precautionary measure warding off impending danger or damage or injury etc.
definitions.zh: n. 预防措施( precaution的名词复数 ); 防备; 避孕措施

examples.en: Take precautions before the storm arrives.
examples.zh: 在暴风雨来临前采取预防措施。

examples.en: We need safety precautions in the lab.
examples.zh: 我们在实验室需要安全预防措施。

definitions.en: n status established in order of importance or urgency
definitions.zh: n. 先( priority的名词复数 ); 优先; 优先权; 优先考虑的事

examples.en: Family is one of my top priorities.
examples.zh: 家庭是我的首要优先事项之一。

examples.en: Set your priorities before starting work.
examples.zh: 开始工作前先设定你的优先事项。

definitions.en: n something given for victory or superiority in a contest or competition or for winning a lottery
definitions.zh: n. 奖赏( prize的名词复数 ); 值得竞争的东西; 难能可贵的事物; 难以争取的重要事物

definitions.en: n goods or money obtained illegally
definitions.zh: v. 珍视, 珍惜( prize的第三人称单数 )

examples.en: She won two prizes in the contest.
examples.zh: 她在比赛中赢得了两个奖项。

examples.en: The prizes were given to the winners.
examples.zh: 奖品颁发给了获胜者。

definitions.en: n a state of difficulty that needs to be resolved
definitions.zh: n. 问题；难题（problem的复数）

examples.en: We need to solve these problems quickly.
examples.zh: 我们需要快速解决这些问题。

examples.en: Math problems can be challenging for students.
examples.zh: 数学问题对学生来说可能很有挑战性。

definitions.en: n commodities offered for sale
definitions.zh: n. 产品；商品（product的复数）

examples.en: The store sells many organic products.
examples.zh: 这家店出售许多有机产品。

examples.en: Our company develops new products every year.
examples.zh: 我们公司每年开发新产品。

definitions.en: n the body of people in a learned occupation
definitions.zh: n. 专业；职业；行业（profession的复数形式）

examples.en: Many professions require special training.
examples.zh: 许多职业需要特殊培训。

examples.en: Teaching and nursing are respected professions.
examples.zh: 教学和护理是受尊重的职业。

definitions.en: n the excess of revenues over outlays in a given period of time (including depreciation and other non-cash expenses)
definitions.zh: n. 收益, 红利；盈利（profit的复数）

examples.en: The company made high profits this year.
examples.zh: 这家公司今年获得了高利润。

examples.en: They reinvested their profits into the business.
examples.zh: 他们将利润再投资到业务中。

definitions.en: n. the branch of cognitive psychology that studies the psychological basis of linguistic competence and performance
definitions.zh: n. 语言心理学

examples.en: Psycholinguistics studies how we learn language.
examples.zh: 心理语言学研究我们如何学习语言。

examples.en: She is taking a course in psycholinguistics.
examples.zh: 她正在修一门心理语言学课程。

definitions.en: a free of extraneous elements of any kind
definitions.zh: a. 纯的( pure的最高级 ); 单纯的; 纯真的; 干净的

examples.en: This water is the purest in the region.
examples.zh: 这水是该地区最纯净的。

examples.en: Her intentions were the purest of all.
examples.zh: 她的意图是所有中最单纯的。

definitions.en: n an attribute that must be met or complied with and that fits a person for something
definitions.zh: n. 职位要求；任职资格；资格证书；限定性条件（qualification的复数形式）

examples.en: He has the right qualifications for the job.
examples.zh: 他具备这份工作的合适资格。

examples.en: Check the qualifications before applying.
examples.zh: 申请前检查资格要求。

definitions.en: n an instance of questioning
definitions.zh: n. 问题（question的复数）

examples.en: Please ask questions if you are unsure.
examples.zh: 如果不确定，请提问。

examples.en: The teacher answered all our questions.
examples.zh: 老师回答了我们所有的问题。

definitions.en: n a person who enjoys reading
definitions.zh: n. 读者, 读物（reader的复数形式）

examples.en: The book has many young readers.
examples.zh: 这本书有很多年轻读者。

examples.en: Readers enjoy stories about adventure.
examples.zh: 读者喜欢关于冒险的故事。

definitions.en: n a rational motive for a belief or action
definitions.zh: n. 理由；理智；原因（reason的复数）

examples.en: There are many reasons to learn English.
examples.zh: 有很多理由学习英语。

examples.en: She explained her reasons for leaving.
examples.zh: 她解释了她离开的原因。

definitions.en: n anything (such as a document or a phonograph record or a photograph) providing permanent evidence of or information about past events
definitions.zh: n. 记录, 录音；唱片, 档案（record的复数形式）

examples.en: Keep records of all your expenses.
examples.zh: 记录你所有的开支。

examples.en: He collects old vinyl records.
examples.zh: 他收集旧黑胶唱片。

definitions.en: n (sports) the chief official (as in boxing or American football) who is expected to ensure fair play
definitions.zh: n. 裁判员( referee的名词复数 ); 证明人; 公断人; （专业性强的文章的）审阅人

examples.en: The referees made fair decisions during the game.
examples.zh: 裁判在比赛中做出了公正的判决。

examples.en: Two referees reviewed the research paper.
examples.zh: 两位审阅人评审了这篇研究论文。

definitions.en: n snacks and drinks served as a light meal
definitions.zh: n. 茶点；点心；小吃

examples.en: Light refreshments will be served after the meeting.
examples.zh: 会议后将提供简单的茶点。

examples.en: We enjoyed refreshments during the break.
examples.zh: 我们在休息时享用了点心。

definitions.en: n an authoritative rule
definitions.zh: n. 章则；条例；规程（regulation的复数）

examples.en: Follow the safety regulations in the factory.
examples.zh: 遵守工厂的安全条例。

examples.en: New regulations were introduced last month.
examples.zh: 上个月引入了新规程。

definitions.en: n. mutual dealings or connections or communications among persons or groups
definitions.zh: n. 交往, 关系, 事务

examples.en: Good relations between countries promote peace.
examples.zh: 国家间的良好关系促进和平。

examples.en: They have friendly relations with their neighbors.
examples.zh: 他们与邻居有友好的关系。

definitions.en: n a written document describing the findings of some individual or group
definitions.zh: n. 报表；专题；报告（report的复数）

examples.en: The manager reads daily reports every morning.
examples.zh: 经理每天早上阅读每日报告。

examples.en: She writes reports for the school newspaper.
examples.zh: 她为校报写专题报告。

definitions.en: n someone who lives at a particular place for a prolonged period or who was born there
definitions.zh: n. 居民；房客；住院医生（resident的复数）

examples.en: The residents of the town are friendly.
examples.zh: 这个镇的居民很友好。

examples.en: New residents must register at the office.
examples.zh: 新居民必须在办公室登记。

definitions.en: n available source of wealth; a new or reserve supply that can be drawn upon when needed
definitions.zh: n. 资源；物力（resource的复数）

examples.en: We need more resources to finish the project.
examples.zh: 我们需要更多资源来完成项目。

examples.en: Natural resources should be used wisely.
examples.zh: 自然资源应该被明智地使用。

definitions.en: n the codefendant (especially in a divorce proceeding) who is accused of adultery with the corespondent
definitions.zh: n. <律>（尤指离婚案的）被告( respondent的名词复数 ); 回答问题的人, （尤指）调查对象

examples.en: All respondents completed the survey online.
examples.zh: 所有调查对象在线完成了问卷。

examples.en: The respondents gave honest answers.
examples.zh: 调查对象给出了诚实的回答。

definitions.en: n a building where people go to eat
definitions.zh: n. 饭店( restaurant的名词复数 ); 餐馆; 饭馆; 菜馆

examples.en: There are many restaurants near the park.
examples.zh: 公园附近有很多餐馆。

examples.en: We tried two new restaurants this week.
examples.zh: 这周我们尝试了两家新饭店。

definitions.en: n a phenomenon that follows and is caused by some previous phenomenon
definitions.zh: n. 结果；成绩（result的复数）

examples.en: The test results will be out tomorrow.
examples.zh: 测试结果明天出来。

examples.en: Good results come from hard work.
examples.zh: 好结果来自努力工作。

definitions.en: n the selling of goods to consumers; usually in small quantities and not for resale
definitions.zh: v. 零售；转述（retail的第三人称单数）

examples.en: The store retails clothes at low prices.
examples.zh: 这家店以低价零售服装。

examples.en: He retails stories about his travels.
examples.zh: 他转述他旅行的故事。

definitions.en: n a traveler who actively rides an animal (as a horse or camel)
definitions.zh: n. 骑（马、自行车等）的人( rider的名词复数 ); 乘客; 附文; 附加条款

examples.en: The riders wore helmets for safety.
examples.zh: 骑手们戴头盔以确保安全。

examples.en: Bus riders must pay the fare.
examples.zh: 公交车乘客必须付车费。

definitions.en: n a source of danger; a possibility of incurring loss or misfortune
definitions.zh: n. 风险, 危险（risk复数）

examples.en: Taking risks can lead to success.
examples.zh: 冒险可以带来成功。

examples.en: We must assess the risks before acting.
examples.zh: 我们必须在行动前评估风险。

definitions.en: n a mechanism that can move automatically
definitions.zh: n. 机器人（robot的复数形式）

examples.en: Robots help build cars in factories.
examples.zh: 机器人在工厂里帮助制造汽车。

examples.en: Some robots can clean your house.
examples.zh: 有些机器人可以打扫你的房子。

definitions.en: n a lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
definitions.zh: n. 岩石, 岩礁；岩石礁石（rock复数形式）

examples.en: The children threw rocks into the river.
examples.zh: 孩子们把岩石扔进河里。

examples.en: We climbed over big rocks on the trail.
examples.zh: 我们在小路上爬过大岩石。

definitions.en: n an arrangement of objects or people side by side in a line
definitions.zh: n. 返回引用中的行数；行（row的复数形式）

examples.en: The students sat in neat rows.
examples.zh: 学生们坐在整齐的行里。

examples.en: We planted flowers in two rows.
examples.zh: 我们种了两行花。

definitions.en: n a principle or condition that customarily governs behavior
definitions.zh: n. 规则；条例（rule的复数形式）

examples.en: Follow the rules of the game.
examples.zh: 遵守游戏规则。

examples.en: School rules help keep everyone safe.
examples.zh: 学校规则有助于保证每个人的安全。

definitions.en: n. a fund of money put by as a reserve
definitions.zh: n. 储蓄, 存款
[经] 储金, 储蓄

examples.en: She keeps her savings in a bank account.
examples.zh: 她把储蓄存在银行账户里。

examples.en: We used our savings to buy a house.
examples.zh: 我们用存款买了房子。

definitions.en: n a person with advanced knowledge of one or more sciences
definitions.zh: n. 科学家( scientist的名词复数 )

examples.en: Scientists study the effects of climate change.
examples.zh: 科学家研究气候变化的影响。

examples.en: Many scientists work in research laboratories.
examples.zh: 许多科学家在研究实验室工作。

definitions.en: n an area that includes places where several people can sit
definitions.zh: n. 座椅, 座位（seat的复数形式）

examples.en: Please take your seats before the show starts.
examples.zh: 请在演出开始前就座。

examples.en: There are enough seats for everyone.
examples.zh: 有足够的座位给每个人。

definitions.zh: a. 用过的, 旧货的, 旧的, 间接的, 传来的, 第二手的
[机] 半新的, 旧货

examples.en: She bought a second-hand car last week.
examples.zh: 她上周买了一辆二手车。

examples.en: I prefer second-hand books to new ones.
examples.zh: 比起新书，我更喜欢二手书。

definitions.en: n. the act of defending yourself
definitions.zh: n. 自卫, 自卫术, 自卫权
[法] 自卫, 正当防卫

examples.en: She learned self-defense to stay safe.
examples.zh: 她学习自卫以保持安全。

examples.en: Self-defense classes teach useful techniques.
examples.zh: 自卫课程教授有用的技巧。

definitions.en: n. the trait of practicing self discipline
definitions.zh: n. 自我训练, 自我修养, 自律
[法] 自律, 自我约束, 自我修养

examples.en: Self-discipline helps you achieve your goals.
examples.zh: 自律帮助你实现目标。

examples.en: He practices self-discipline every day.
examples.zh: 他每天练习自律。

definitions.en: s. able to provide for your own needs without help from others
definitions.zh: a. 自给自足的, 极为自负的

examples.en: The village is self-sufficient in food.
examples.zh: 这个村庄在食物上自给自足。

examples.en: She wants to be self-sufficient and independent.
examples.zh: 她想要自给自足且独立。

definitions.en: n a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of a language
definitions.zh: n. [律]判决, 宣判; 句子（ sentence的名词复数 ）

definitions.en: n (criminal law) a final judgment of guilty in a criminal case and the punishment that is imposed
definitions.zh: v. 宣判, 判决（ sentence的第三人称单数 ）

examples.en: These sentences are easy to understand.
examples.zh: 这些句子很容易理解。

examples.en: The judge read the sentences aloud.
examples.zh: 法官宣读了判决。

definitions.en: n a particular situation
definitions.zh: n. 鞋子（shoe的复数）

examples.en: I need new shoes for running.
examples.zh: 我需要新跑鞋。

examples.en: Her shoes are very comfortable.
examples.zh: 她的鞋子非常舒适。

definitions.en: n the piece of land on which something is located (or is to be located)
definitions.zh: n. 遗址, 举办地点；网站（site的复数）

examples.en: These historical sites are popular.
examples.zh: 这些历史遗址很受欢迎。

examples.en: We visited several ancient sites.
examples.zh: 我们参观了几处古代遗址。

definitions.en: n the physical magnitude of something (how big it is)
definitions.zh: n. 象素显示尺寸, 尺寸（size复数形式）

examples.en: The store has many shoe sizes.
examples.zh: 这家店有很多鞋码。

examples.en: Different sizes fit different people.
examples.zh: 不同尺寸适合不同的人。

definitions.en: n an ability that has been acquired by training
definitions.zh: n. 技术；技能；技巧（skill的复数形式）

examples.en: He has excellent cooking skills.
examples.zh: 他有出色的烹饪技巧。

examples.en: Learning new skills takes time.
examples.zh: 学习新技能需要时间。

definitions.en: n a person who smokes tobacco
definitions.zh: n. 吸烟者( smoker的名词复数 )

examples.en: Smokers should consider their health.
examples.zh: 吸烟者应考虑自己的健康。

examples.en: Many smokers try to quit.
examples.zh: 许多吸烟者试图戒烟。

definitions.en: n a light informal meal
definitions.zh: n. 快餐；小吃；零嘴（snack的复数）

examples.en: We bought some snacks for the trip.
examples.zh: 我们为旅行买了一些零食。

examples.en: Healthy snacks are good for you.
examples.zh: 健康的零食对你有益。

definitions.en: n the place where something begins, where it springs into being
definitions.zh: n. 输入源；发起者；来源（source的复数）

examples.en: We need reliable sources of information.
examples.zh: 我们需要可靠的信息来源。

examples.en: The river has many sources.
examples.zh: 这条河有许多源头。

definitions.en: n something of sentimental value
definitions.zh: n. 纪念品( souvenir的名词复数 )

examples.en: She bought souvenirs from the market.
examples.zh: 她从市场买了纪念品。

examples.en: These souvenirs remind me of my trip.
examples.zh: 这些纪念品让我想起我的旅行。

definitions.en: n a piece of cutlery with a shallow bowl-shaped container and a handle; used to stir or serve or take up food
definitions.zh: n. 匙, 调羹( spoon的名词复数 ); 一匙的量

examples.en: We need clean spoons for dinner.
examples.zh: 我们需要干净的勺子吃晚餐。

examples.en: The spoons are in the drawer.
examples.zh: 勺子在抽屉里。

definitions.en: n an active diversion requiring physical exertion and competition
definitions.zh: n. (英)运动会, 运动的, 适用于运动的, 运动会的, 与运动会有关的

examples.en: I enjoy watching sports on TV.
examples.zh: 我喜欢在电视上看体育比赛。

examples.en: Sports keep you healthy and active.
examples.zh: 运动让你保持健康和活跃。

definitions.en: n a basis for comparison; a reference point against which other things can be evaluated
definitions.zh: n. 标准；规格（standard的复数）

examples.en: The school has high academic standards.
examples.zh: 这所学校有很高的学术标准。

examples.en: We must meet safety standards.
examples.zh: 我们必须达到安全标准。

definitions.en: n. (Roman Catholic Church) a devotion consisting of fourteen prayers said before a series of fourteen pictures or carvings representing successive incidents during Jesus' passage from Pilate's house to his crucifixion at Calvary
definitions.zh: n. 车站；驻地；位置（station的复数形式）

examples.en: The train stations are very busy.
examples.zh: 火车站非常繁忙。

examples.en: We waited at the bus stations.
examples.zh: 我们在公交车站等待。

definitions.en: n. the course along which a person has walked or is walking in
definitions.zh: n. （楼外的）台阶；步伐；步幅；步数

examples.en: Take small steps to reach your goal.
examples.zh: 采取小步骤来实现你的目标。

examples.en: The steps lead to the garden.
examples.zh: 台阶通向花园。

definitions.en: n a lump or mass of hard consolidated mineral matter
definitions.zh: n. 小石头；石子（stone的复数）

examples.en: The path is covered with stones.
examples.zh: 小路上铺满了石头。

examples.en: Children threw stones into the river.
examples.zh: 孩子们把石头扔进河里。

definitions.en: n a mercantile establishment for the retail sale of goods or services
definitions.zh: n. (英)百货商店

definitions.en: n a supply of something available for future use
definitions.zh: a. 贮藏的, 用作贮藏处的, 贮存的

examples.en: The stores close at nine o'clock.
examples.zh: 商店九点关门。

examples.en: We have food stores for winter.
examples.zh: 我们有冬季的食物储备。

definitions.en: a having strength or power greater than average or expected
definitions.zh: [经] 强劲的

examples.en: Exercise makes you stronger every day.
examples.zh: 锻炼让你每天更强壮。

examples.en: The wind grew stronger at night.
examples.zh: 晚上风变得更强劲了。

definitions.en: n a detailed critical inspection
definitions.zh: n. 研究；学习；学业（study的复数）

examples.en: Her studies focus on marine biology.
examples.zh: 她的研究专注于海洋生物学。

examples.en: He finished his studies last year.
examples.zh: 他去年完成了学业。

definitions.en: n how something is done or how it happens
definitions.zh: n. 风格；样式；模式（style的复数形式）

examples.en: There are many different hair styles.
examples.zh: 有许多不同的发型。

examples.en: She likes modern styles of clothing.
examples.zh: 她喜欢现代风格的服装。

definitions.en: n the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
definitions.zh: n. 主题；被试者；学科；科目（subject的复数）

examples.en: Math and science are my favorite subjects.
examples.zh: 数学和科学是我最喜欢的科目。

examples.en: We discussed several interesting subjects.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了几个有趣的主题。

definitions.en: n translation of foreign dialogue of a movie or TV program; usually displayed at the bottom of the screen
definitions.zh: n. 说明字幕, 印在外国影片上的对白翻译字幕, 译文对白字幕

examples.en: I watch movies with English subtitles.
examples.zh: 我看带有英文字幕的电影。

examples.en: Subtitles help me understand the dialogue.
examples.zh: 字幕帮助我理解对话。

definitions.en: n an idea that is suggested
definitions.zh: n. 民众意见箱；员工意见箱

examples.en: Please write your suggestions on the form.
examples.zh: 请把你的建议写在表格上。

examples.en: Her suggestions were very helpful.
examples.zh: 她的建议非常有帮助。

definitions.en: n instrumentality that combines interrelated interacting artifacts designed to work as a coherent entity
definitions.zh: n. 体制, 体系；制度；系统（system的复数形式）

examples.en: The school uses new computer systems.
examples.zh: 学校使用新的计算机系统。

examples.en: Good systems make work easier.
examples.zh: 好的系统让工作更轻松。

definitions.en: n a set of data arranged in rows and columns
definitions.zh: n. 桌子；附录；表格（table的复数）

examples.en: The tables are made of wood.
examples.zh: 这些桌子是木头做的。

examples.en: Please look at the data tables.
examples.zh: 请看数据表格。

definitions.en: n a slab of stone or wood suitable for bearing an inscription
definitions.zh: n. 药片( tablet的名词复数 ); （木、竹）简; 碑; 一块肥皂

examples.en: The doctor prescribed two tablets daily.
examples.zh: 医生开了每天两片药。

examples.en: Ancient tablets contain important writings.
examples.zh: 古代碑刻包含重要的文字。

definitions.en: n a cooperative unit (especially in sports)
definitions.zh: n. 团队, 参赛队伍（team的复数形式）

examples.en: Both teams played very well.
examples.zh: 两支队伍都打得很好。

examples.en: Our teams work together on projects.
examples.zh: 我们的团队在项目上合作。

definitions.en: n a practical method or art applied to some particular task
definitions.zh: n. 方法；技巧；技术（technique的复数）

examples.en: She learned new painting techniques.
examples.zh: 她学习了新的绘画技巧。

examples.en: These techniques improve your writing.
examples.zh: 这些技巧能提高你的写作。

definitions.en: n the kind and number and arrangement of teeth (collectively) in a person or animal
definitions.zh: pl. 牙齿

definitions.en: n hard bonelike structures in the jaws of vertebrates; used for biting and chewing or for attack and defense
definitions.zh: [医] 牙

examples.en: Brush your teeth every morning.
examples.zh: 每天早上刷牙。

examples.en: His teeth are white and strong.
examples.zh: 他的牙齿又白又坚固。

definitions.en: n place of worship consisting of an edifice for the worship of a deity
definitions.zh: n. 边撑, 伸幅器；寺庙（temple的复数形式）

examples.en: We visited ancient temples in Japan.
examples.zh: 我们参观了日本的古老寺庙。

examples.en: The temples are beautiful and quiet.
examples.zh: 这些寺庙美丽而宁静。

definitions.en: n the content of cognition; the main thing you are thinking about
definitions.zh: n. 思想；思维；想法（thought的复数）

examples.en: Share your thoughts with the group.
examples.zh: 和小组分享你的想法。

examples.en: Her thoughts were full of hope.
examples.zh: 她的想法充满希望。

definitions.en: n something that is a source of danger
definitions.zh: n. 威胁, 恐吓( threat的名词复数 ); 可能造成威胁的人[事, 想法]; 恶兆, 兆头

examples.en: We must address these security threats.
examples.zh: 我们必须处理这些安全威胁。

examples.en: The threats were taken seriously.
examples.zh: 这些威胁被认真对待。

definitions.en: n a commercial document showing that the holder is entitled to something (as to ride on public transportation or to enter a public entertainment)
definitions.zh: n. 票；罚单（ticket的复数）

examples.en: I bought two tickets for the concert.
examples.zh: 我买了两张音乐会的票。

examples.en: He got a parking ticket yesterday.
examples.zh: 他昨天收到了一张停车罚单。

definitions.en: n a flat thin rectangular slab (as of fired clay or rubber or linoleum) used to cover surfaces
definitions.zh: n. 瓷砖（tile的复数形式）

examples.en: The bathroom has blue tiles on the wall.
examples.zh: 浴室墙上有蓝色瓷砖。

examples.en: We need to replace some broken tiles.
examples.zh: 我们需要更换一些破损的瓷砖。

definitions.en: n the quality of a person's voice
definitions.zh: n. 声调；基本音色（tone的复数）

examples.en: Her voice had gentle tones.
examples.zh: 她的声音有柔和的语调。

examples.en: Different tones convey different emotions.
examples.zh: 不同的语调传达不同的情感。

definitions.en: n an implement used in the practice of a vocation
definitions.zh: n. 工具, 工具菜单；工具箱（tool的复数形式）

examples.en: He keeps his tools in the garage.
examples.zh: 他把工具放在车库里。

examples.en: These tools are useful for gardening.
examples.zh: 这些工具对园艺很有用。

definitions.en: n the subject matter of a conversation or discussion
definitions.zh: abbr. 总联机程序和信息控制系统（Total On-line Program and Information Control System）

examples.en: We discussed many interesting topics.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了许多有趣的话题。

examples.en: The teacher chose topics for the essay.
examples.zh: 老师为作文选择了主题。

definitions.en: n someone who travels for pleasure
definitions.zh: n. 旅行者, 观光客( tourist的名词复数 )

examples.en: Many tourists visit the city every year.
examples.zh: 每年有许多游客参观这座城市。

examples.en: Tourists enjoy taking photos here.
examples.zh: 游客喜欢在这里拍照。

definitions.en: n an artifact designed to be played with
definitions.zh: n. 玩具（toy的复数）

examples.en: The children play with their toys.
examples.zh: 孩子们玩他们的玩具。

examples.en: These toys are safe for kids.
examples.zh: 这些玩具对孩子安全。

definitions.en: n a person who changes location
definitions.zh: n. 旅行者；旅客（traveler的复数形式）

examples.en: Travelers need to pack light.
examples.zh: 旅行者需要轻装出行。

examples.en: Many travelers explore new cultures.
examples.zh: 许多旅行者探索新文化。

definitions.en: n a tall perennial woody plant having a main trunk and branches forming a distinct elevated crown; includes both gymnosperms and angiosperms
definitions.zh: n. 树木；乔木；树状结构（tree的复数）

examples.en: The trees in the park are tall.
examples.zh: 公园里的树很高。

examples.en: We planted new trees in the garden.
examples.zh: 我们在花园里种了新树。

definitions.en: n a general direction in which something tends to move
definitions.zh: n. 动态, 趋势

examples.en: Fashion trends change every season.
examples.zh: 时尚趋势每个季节都在变化。

examples.en: We follow the latest trends in technology.
examples.zh: 我们关注最新的科技趋势。

definitions.en: n something given or done as an expression of esteem
definitions.zh: n. （尤指旧时一国向他国交纳的）贡品( tribute的名词复数 ); （良好效果或影响的）体现; （尤指对死者的）致敬; 称赞

examples.en: They paid tributes to the brave soldiers.
examples.zh: 他们向勇敢的士兵致敬。

examples.en: Flowers are tributes to her memory.
examples.zh: 鲜花是对她记忆的致敬。

definitions.en: n a passageway through or under something, usually underground (especially one for trains or cars)
definitions.zh: n. 隧道, 地道( tunnel的名词复数 ); （动物栖息的）穴

examples.en: The train goes through long tunnels.
examples.zh: 火车穿过长长的隧道。

examples.en: Rabbits dig tunnels underground.
examples.zh: 兔子在地下挖洞穴。

definitions.en: n a subdivision of a particular kind of thing
definitions.zh: v. 打字（type的第三人称单数形式）

examples.en: There are many types of flowers.
examples.zh: 有许多种类的花。

examples.en: She types very fast on the keyboard.
examples.zh: 她在键盘上打字很快。

definitions.en: n the body of faculty and students at a university
definitions.zh: n. 大学( university的名词复数 )

examples.en: Many students apply to universities abroad.
examples.zh: 许多学生申请国外的大学。

examples.en: Universities offer a wide range of courses.
examples.zh: 大学提供广泛的课程。

definitions.en: s. reflecting the latest information or changes
definitions.zh: a. 直到现在的, 最近的, 现代化的

definitions.en: s. in accord with the most fashionable ideas or style
definitions.zh: [化] 最新的

examples.en: The software is up-to-date.
examples.zh: 这个软件是最新的。

examples.en: She keeps her records up-to-date.
examples.zh: 她保持记录是现代化的。

definitions.en: n an implement for practical use (especially in a household)
definitions.zh: n. 器具, 用具, 器皿( utensil的名词复数 ); 器物

examples.en: We need clean utensils for cooking.
examples.zh: 我们需要干净的烹饪用具。

examples.en: She put the utensils on the table.
examples.zh: 她把餐具放在桌子上。

definitions.en: n being unoccupied
definitions.zh: n. 空缺额；缺位（vacancy复数）

examples.en: The hotel has no vacancies tonight.
examples.zh: 酒店今晚没有空房。

examples.en: There are job vacancies in the company.
examples.zh: 公司有职位空缺。

definitions.en: n an injectable form of benzodiazepine (trade name Versed) useful for sedation and for reducing pain during uncomfortable medical procedures
definitions.zh: a. 熟练的, 精通的

examples.en: He is well versed in French literature.
examples.zh: 他精通法国文学。

examples.en: She is versed in many programming languages.
examples.zh: 她精通多种编程语言。

definitions.en: n the visible part of a television transmission
definitions.zh: n. 视频文件；影像资料（video的复数）

examples.en: We watch videos online every day.
examples.zh: 我们每天在线看视频。

examples.en: She uploads videos to her channel.
examples.zh: 她把视频上传到她的频道。

definitions.en: n an endorsement made in a passport that allows the bearer to enter the country issuing it
definitions.zh: n. 签证( visa的名词复数 )

examples.en: They need visas to travel abroad.
examples.zh: 他们需要签证出国旅行。

examples.en: She applied for a student visa.
examples.zh: 她申请了学生签证。

definitions.en: n someone who visits
definitions.zh: n. 访问者, 游客（visitor 复数）

examples.en: The museum welcomes many visitors daily.
examples.zh: 博物馆每天欢迎许多游客。

examples.en: Visitors must follow the park rules.
examples.zh: 游客必须遵守公园规则。

definitions.en: n (military) a person who freely enlists for service
definitions.zh: n. 义务工作者( volunteer的名词复数 ); 志愿者; 自告奋勇者; 主动做某事的人

definitions.en: n a person who performs voluntary work
definitions.zh: v. 自动提供, 自愿效劳( volunteer的第三人称单数 ); 主动建议（或告诉）; （未经当事人同意）举荐; 自愿参军, 当志愿兵

examples.en: Volunteers help clean the park.
examples.zh: 志愿者帮忙清理公园。

examples.en: She volunteers at the local hospital.
examples.zh: 她在当地医院做志愿者。

definitions.zh: n. 水钟, 滴漏

examples.en: The water-clock measured time in ancient days.
examples.zh: 水钟在古代测量时间。

examples.en: They used a water-clock for timing speeches.
examples.zh: 他们用水钟计时演讲。

definitions.zh: [医] 防水的, 不透水的

examples.en: This jacket is completely water-proof.
examples.zh: 这件夹克完全防水。

examples.en: We need water-proof boots for hiking.
examples.zh: 我们需要防水靴去远足。

definitions.en: n. skiing on water while being towed by a motorboat
definitions.zh: n. 滑水

examples.en: Water-skiing is a fun summer sport.
examples.zh: 滑水是一项有趣的夏季运动。

examples.en: She enjoys water-skiing on the lake.
examples.zh: 她喜欢在湖上滑水。

definitions.en: n. a black garment (dress) worn by a widow as a sign of mourning
definitions.zh: n. 丧服

examples.en: The garden is full of weeds.
examples.zh: 花园里长满了杂草。

examples.en: She wore black weeds after her husband died.
examples.zh: 丈夫去世后，她穿着黑色丧服。

definitions.en: n any day except Sunday (and sometimes except Saturday)
definitions.zh: adv. 在每个周日, 在平时每天

examples.en: I work on weekdays from Monday to Friday.
examples.zh: 我周一到周五工作。

examples.en: The library is open on weekdays.
examples.zh: 图书馆在工作日开放。

definitions.en: n a time period usually extending from Friday night through Sunday; more loosely defined as any period of successive days including one and only one Sunday
definitions.zh: adv. 在每周末

examples.en: We relax on weekends.
examples.zh: 我们在周末放松。

examples.en: She visits her family on weekends.
examples.zh: 她周末去看望家人。

definitions.en: n a very large person; impressive in size or qualities
definitions.zh: n. 鲸, 鲸鱼( whale的名词复数 )

examples.en: Whales are the largest animals on Earth.
examples.zh: 鲸鱼是地球上最大的动物。

examples.en: We saw whales swimming in the ocean.
examples.zh: 我们看到鲸鱼在海洋中游泳。

definitions.en: n a simple machine consisting of a circular frame with spokes (or a solid disc) that can rotate on a shaft or axle (as in vehicles or other machines)
definitions.zh: n. 旋转；车轮（wheel的复数）

examples.en: The car has four wheels.
examples.zh: 汽车有四个轮子。

examples.en: Bicycle wheels need air to move smoothly.
examples.zh: 自行车轮子需要空气才能平稳行驶。

definitions.zh: 伍伦贡[澳大利亚东南部港市]

examples.en: Wollongong is a city in Australia.
examples.zh: 伍伦贡是澳大利亚的一个城市。

examples.en: She studies at the University of Wollongong.
examples.zh: 她在伍伦贡大学学习。

definitions.en: n. the words that are spoken
definitions.zh: n. 言语；话语；字（word的复数）

examples.en: She spoke kind words to everyone.
examples.zh: 她对每个人说了善意的话语。

examples.en: He wrote many words in his diary.
examples.zh: 他在日记里写了很多字。

definitions.en: n small workplace where handcrafts or manufacturing are done
definitions.zh: n. 专题讨论会( workshop的名词复数 ); 车间; 工作坊; 研究会

examples.en: The company holds workshops for employees.
examples.zh: 公司为员工举办研讨会。

examples.en: She attended a writing workshop.
examples.zh: 她参加了一个写作工作坊。

definitions.en: v. examine by taking x-rays
definitions.zh: a. X射线的

definitions.en: v. take an x-ray of something or somebody
definitions.zh: vt. 用X光检查, 照X光
vi. 使用X光

examples.en: The doctor will x-ray your arm today.
examples.zh: 医生今天会给你胳膊拍X光片。

examples.en: She needs an x-ray of her chest.
examples.zh: 她需要拍一张胸部X光片。
